model.apac_sales_etl.int_billing__arias_.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Arias enriched
-- Source:  {{ ref('stg_billing__arias') }}
-- Output:  apac_billing_silver.int_billing__arias_enriched (table)
-- Applies Silver baseline business logic: HB team filter, BusinessType / RecurringRevenue derivation,
-- hardcoded RevenueCountry/Currency, SystemID/TX_ID/ClientID construction. Conforms to the 18-column
-- standard schema that all 8 baselines feed into fct_billing_baseline.
-- Every text column is explicitly cast so the CTAS materialization has no type inference to do
-- (otherwise Fabric Warehouse infers nvarchar(500) which isn't supported).

with stg as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_billing__arias') }}
    where TeamName <> 'HB' or TeamName is null
),

-- Synthetic key fallback chain: natural id -> client name -> TX id (marked) -> row hash (marked).
-- Guarantees SystemID/ClientID are never null; -TX- / -SYN- markers keep synthetic rows identifiable.
keyed as (
    select
        *,
        cast(
            case
                when PolicyNo is not null and PolicyNo <> ''
                    then 'ARIAS-' + PolicyNo
                when ClientName is not null and ltrim(rtrim(ClientName)) <> ''
                    then 'ARIAS-' + upper(ltrim(rtrim(ClientName)))
                when InvoiceNumber is not null and InvoiceNumber <> ''
                    then 'ARIAS-TX-' + InvoiceNumber
                else 'ARIAS-SYN-' + convert(varchar(64), hashbytes('SHA2_256',
                         concat(InsuranceType, '|', InceptionDate, '|', Revenue, '|', RecurringFlag)), 2)
            end
            as varchar(500)
        )                                                                       as SystemIdCalc
    from stg
),

derived as (
    select
        cast(ClientName as varchar(500))                                       as SystemClientName,
        cast(InsuranceType as varchar(255))                                    as SystemProductClass,
        cast(
            case
                when InvoiceNumber is null or InvoiceNumber = '' then null
                else 'ARIAS-' + InvoiceNumber
            end
            as varchar(150)
        )                                                                       as TX_ID,
        InceptionDate                                                          as IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue,
        Premium,
        SystemIdCalc                                                           as SystemID,
        cast('Japan' as varchar(50))                                           as RevenueCountry,
        cast(coalesce(nullif(Gcid, ''), SystemIdCalc) as varchar(500))         as ClientID,
        cast('ARIAS' as varchar(50))                                           as DataSource,
        cast('CRB'   as varchar(50))                                           as Segment,
        cast(
            case
                when RecurringFlag = 'N' then 'New Business'
                when RecurringFlag = 'R' then 'Renewal'
                else RecurringFlag
            end
            as varchar(50)
        )                                                                       as BusinessType,
        cast(
            case
                when RecurringFlag = 'R' then 'Y'
                when RecurringFlag = 'N' then 'N'
                else RecurringFlag
            end
            as varchar(10)
        )                                                                       as RecurringRevenue,
        cast(null as varchar(100))                                             as RevenueCities,
        cast(null as varchar(50))                                              as DUNSNO,
        cast('JPY' as varchar(10))                                             as Currency,
        cast(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(Gcid)), '') as varchar(50))                    as GCID,
        cast('ARIAS' as varchar(50))                                           as [Source]
    from keyed
)

select * from derived

-- Intermediate: CIS Historical enriched (HWC CRM pre-2023)
-- Source:  {{ ref('stg_billing__cis_historical') }}
-- Output:  apac_billing_silver.int_billing__cis_historical_enriched (table)
-- Mirrors the legacy CIS M baseline:
--   - Filter to rows with IncomeInceptionDate < 2023-01-01
--   - Add Source = 'CIS' (DataSource stays whatever the source file has, typically 'CRM')
--   - Conform to baseline 18-col schema (DUNSNO, Currency, GCID = NULL since CIS source doesn't have them)
-- Feeds the unified fct_billing_baseline mart; HWC_CRM (post-2023 D365 path) joins separately.

with stg as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_billing__cis_historical') }}
    where IncomeInceptionDate < cast('2023-01-01' as datetime2(6))
),

-- Synthetic key fallback chain: source SystemID -> client name -> TX id (marked) -> row hash (marked).
-- Guarantees SystemID/ClientID are never null; -TX- / -SYN- markers keep synthetic rows identifiable.
keyed as (
    select
        *,
        cast(
            case
                when SystemID is not null and SystemID <> ''
                    then SystemID
                when SystemClientName is not null and ltrim(rtrim(SystemClientName)) <> ''
                    then 'CIS-' + upper(ltrim(rtrim(SystemClientName)))
                when TX_ID is not null and TX_ID <> ''
                    then 'CIS-TX-' + TX_ID
                else 'CIS-SYN-' + convert(varchar(64), hashbytes('SHA2_256',
                         concat(SystemProductClass, '|', IncomeInceptionDate, '|', Revenue, '|', RevenueCountry)), 2)
            end
            as varchar(500)
        )                                                                       as SystemIdCalc
    from stg
),

derived as (
    select
        cast(SystemClientName as varchar(500))                                 as SystemClientName,
        cast(SystemProductClass as varchar(255))                               as SystemProductClass,
        cast(TX_ID as varchar(150))                                            as TX_ID,
        IncomeInceptionDate                                                    as IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue                                                                as Revenue,
        cast(0.0 as decimal(18,2))                                             as Premium,
        SystemIdCalc                                                           as SystemID,
        cast(RevenueCountry as varchar(50))                                    as RevenueCountry,
        cast(coalesce(nullif(ClientID, ''), SystemIdCalc) as varchar(500))     as ClientID,
        cast(DataSource as varchar(50))                                        as DataSource,
        cast(Segment as varchar(50))                                           as Segment,
        cast(BusinessType as varchar(50))                                      as BusinessType,
        cast(RecurringRevenue as varchar(10))                                  as RecurringRevenue,
        cast(RevenueCities as varchar(100))                                    as RevenueCities,
        cast(null as varchar(50))                                              as DUNSNO,
        cast(null as varchar(10))                                              as Currency,
        cast(null as varchar(50))                                              as GCID,
        cast('CIS' as varchar(50))                                             as [Source],
        cast([SubProduct/Service] as varchar(255))                             as [SubProduct/Service],
        cast([Product/Service] as varchar(255))                                as [Product/Service]
    from keyed

model.apac_sales_etl.int_billing__eclips.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Eclipse CRB enriched
-- Source:  {{ ref('stg_billing__eclipse_crb') }}
-- Output:  apac_billing_silver.int_billing__eclipse_crb_enriched (table)
-- Indonesia and Taiwan legal entities filtered. Currency=USD hardcoded. RevenueCountry derived from
-- BusinessUnit+Team (Singapore retail) or LegalEntity text-contains (HK / Philippines / Indonesia).
-- Eclipse populates SystemProductClass2 (= ClassOfBusiness) -- other sources NULL pad it in the mart.

with stg as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_billing__eclipse_crb') }}
    where LegalEntity not in (
        'PT. Willis Reinsurance Brokers Indonesia',
        'Willis Towers Watson Taiwan Limited'
    )
),

-- Synthetic key fallback chain: natural id -> client name -> TX id (marked) -> row hash (marked).
-- Guarantees SystemID/ClientID are never null; -TX- / -SYN- markers keep synthetic rows identifiable.
keyed as (
    select
        *,
        cast(
            case
                when InsuredId is not null and InsuredId <> ''
                    then 'ECLIPSE-' + InsuredId
                when Insured is not null and ltrim(rtrim(Insured)) <> ''
                    then 'ECLIPSE-' + upper(ltrim(rtrim(Insured)))
                when PolicyRef is not null and PolicyRef <> ''
                    then 'ECLIPSE-TX-' + PolicyRef
                else 'ECLIPSE-SYN-' + convert(varchar(64), hashbytes('SHA2_256',
                         concat(BusinessUnit, '|', Team, '|', ClassOfBusiness, '|', InceptionDate, '|', NetBkgeUsdPlan)), 2)
            end
            as varchar(500)
        )                                                                       as SystemIdCalc
    from stg
),

derived as (
    select
        cast(Insured as varchar(500))                                          as SystemClientName,
        cast(BusinessUnit + '+' + Team + '+' + ClassOfBusiness as varchar(500))as SystemProductClass,
        cast(ClassOfBusiness as varchar(255))                                  as SystemProductClass2,
        cast(PolicyRef as varchar(150))                                        as TX_ID,
        InceptionDate                                                          as IncomeInceptionDate,
        NetBkgeUsdPlan                                                         as Revenue,
        GrossPremNonTtyUsdPlan                                                 as Premium,
        SystemIdCalc                                                           as SystemID,
        cast(
            case
                when BusinessUnit + '+' + Team in (
                    'Retail+Corporate', 'Retail+Commercial', 'Retail+FINEX', 'Retail+Network',
                    'Retail+Asia Finex M&A', 'Retail+Asia Placement',
                    'Retail+Client Service Team 1', 'Retail+Client Service Team 2', 'Retail+Client Service Team 3'
                ) then 'Singapore'
                when LegalEntity like '%Hong Kong%'   then 'Hong Kong'
                when LegalEntity like '%Philippines%' then 'Philippines'
                when LegalEntity like '%Indonesia%'   then 'Indonesia'
                else 'Asia Virtual'
            end
            as varchar(50)
        )                                                                       as RevenueCountry,
        cast(coalesce(nullif(WillisPartyId, ''), SystemIdCalc) as varchar(500)) as ClientID,
        cast('ECLIPSE' as varchar(50))                                         as DataSource,
        cast(BuSegment as varchar(50))                                         as Segment,
        cast(
            case
                when RevenueType = 'New/Existing-One Off'    then 'New Business'
                when RevenueType = 'New/New - Recurring'     then 'Renewal'
                when RevenueType = 'New'                     then 'New Business'
                when RevenueType = 'New / New - One-Off'     then 'New Business'
                else RevenueType
            end
            as varchar(50)
        )                                                                       as BusinessType,
        cast(
            case
                when RevenueType in ('New/Existing-One Off', 'New / New - One-Off') then 'N'
                else 'Y'
            end
            as varchar(10)
        )                                                                       as RecurringRevenue,
        cast(null as varchar(100))                                             as RevenueCities,
        cast(DunsNo as varchar(50))                                            as DUNSNO,
        cast('USD' as varchar(10))                                             as Currency,
        cast(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(WillisPartyId)), '') as varchar(50))           as GCID,
        cast('ECLIPSE' as varchar(50))                                         as [Source]
    from keyed
)

select * from derived

-- Intermediate: eGlobal Income enriched
-- Source:  {{ ref('stg_billing__eglobal_income') }}
-- Output:  apac_billing_silver.int_billing__eglobal_income_enriched (table)
-- Non-CRB departments (EMB, RET, EBD, EBC, etc) filtered. RevenueCountry/Currency from SourceName pattern.

with stg as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_billing__eglobal_income') }}
    where Department not in (
        'EMB', 'RET', 'EBD', 'EBC', 'EBM', 'EBS', 'ECS', 'GBM',
        'BEB', 'MEB', 'PEB', 'SEB', 'AEB', 'CEB', 'WEB', 'UEB',
        'HBB', 'HCB'
    )
),

with_country as (
    select
        *,
        cast(
            case
                when SourceName like '%_AU_%' then 'Australia'
                when SourceName like '%_CN.%' then 'China'
                when SourceName like '%_HK.%' then 'Hong Kong'
                when SourceName like '%_ID.%' then 'Indonesia'
                when SourceName like '%_KR.%' then 'South Korea'
                when SourceName like '%_NZ.%' then 'New Zealand'
                when SourceName like '%_PH_%' then 'Philippines'
                when SourceName like '%_RO.%' then 'Australia'
                when SourceName like '%_SG.%' then 'Singapore'
                when SourceName like '%_TW.%' then 'Taiwan'
                else null
            end
            as varchar(50)
        ) as DerivedRevenueCountry,
        cast(
            case
                when SourceName like '%_AU_%' then 'AUD'
                when SourceName like '%_CN.%' then 'CNY'
                when SourceName like '%_HK.%' then 'HKD'
                when SourceName like '%_ID.%' then 'IDR'
                when SourceName like '%_KR.%' then 'KRW'
                when SourceName like '%_NZ.%' then 'NZD'
                when SourceName like '%_PH_%' then 'PHP'
                when SourceName like '%_RO.%' then 'AUD'
                when SourceName like '%_SG.%' then 'SGD'
                when SourceName like '%_TW.%' then 'TWD'
                else null
            end
            as varchar(10)
        ) as DerivedCurrency
    from stg
),

-- Synthetic key fallback chain: natural id (legacy Company+Branch+ClientNo concat, no prefix) ->
-- client name -> TX id (marked) -> row hash (marked). Guarantees SystemID/ClientID are never null.
keyed as (
    select
        *,
        cast(
            case
                when ClientNo is not null and ClientNo <> ''
                    then isnull(Company,'') + isnull(Branch,'') + ClientNo
                when ClientName is not null and ltrim(rtrim(ClientName)) <> ''
                    then 'eGlobal-' + upper(ltrim(rtrim(ClientName)))
                when InvNo is not null and InvNo <> ''
                    then 'eGlobal-TX-' + InvNo
                else 'eGlobal-SYN-' + convert(varchar(64), hashbytes('SHA2_256',
                         concat(Risk, '|', EffectiveDate, '|', TotalIncome, '|', SourceName)), 2)
            end
            as varchar(500)
        )                                                                       as SystemIdCalc
    from with_country
),

derived as (
    select
        cast(ClientName as varchar(500))                                       as SystemClientName,
        cast(Risk as varchar(255))                                             as SystemProductClass,
        cast(InvNo as varchar(150))                                            as TX_ID,
        EffectiveDate                                                          as IncomeInceptionDate,
        TotalIncome                                                            as Revenue,
        Premium                                                                as Premium,
        SystemIdCalc                                                           as SystemID,
        cast(DerivedRevenueCountry as varchar(50))                             as RevenueCountry,
        cast(coalesce(nullif(PartyId, ''), SystemIdCalc) as varchar(500))      as ClientID,
        cast('eGlobal' as varchar(50))                                         as DataSource,
        cast('CRB' as varchar(50))                                             as Segment,
        cast(
            case
                when IncomeClass = 'RRN'         then 'Renewal'
                when IncomeClass in ('MDIAC','MDI') then 'MDI'
                else 'New Business'
            end
            as varchar(50)
        )                                                                       as BusinessType,
        cast(
            case
                when IncomeClass in ('RRN','RNE','RNN') then 'Y'
                else 'N'
            end
            as varchar(10)
        )                                                                       as RecurringRevenue,
        cast(null as varchar(100))                                             as RevenueCities,
        cast(DunsNo as varchar(50))                                            as DUNSNO,
        cast(DerivedCurrency as varchar(10))                                   as Currency,
        cast(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(PartyId)), '') as varchar(50))                 as GCID,
        cast('eGlobal' as varchar(50))                                         as [Source]
    from keyed
)

select * from derived

model.apac_sales_etl.int_billing__ret_or.description: Oracle RET conformed to baseline schema. RET service-offering filter, 22-city mapping, FiscalPeriod YYYYMM fix for older files. GCID from OracleID Mapping (PrimaryCustomerAcctNo = OracleId); ClientID = GCID -> SystemID.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_billing__ret_or.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Oracle RET enriched
-- Source:  {{ ref('stg_billing__ret_oracle') }}
-- Output:  apac_billing_silver.int_billing__ret_oracle_enriched (table)
-- TW_Service_Offering must start with "RET". Segment=RET, BusinessType=Renewal, Currency=USD hardcoded.
-- GCID via OracleID Mapping: left join stg_billing__oracle_mapping on PrimaryCustomerAcctNo = OracleId.
-- FiscalPeriod fix: 8 older files store dates as YYYYMM integers -- reconstruct to first-of-month.

with stg as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_billing__ret_oracle') }}
    where TwServiceOffering like 'RET%'
),

oracle_mapping as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_billing__oracle_mapping') }}
),

-- GCID attached FIRST (mirrors the legacy M merge order) -- ClientID below depends on it,
-- and any future SystemID logic can use it without restructuring.
mapped as (
    select
        s.*,
        m.Gcid
    from stg s
    left join oracle_mapping m
        on s.PrimaryCustomerAcctNo = m.OracleId
),

fiscal_period_fixed as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when SourceName in (
                'Retirement Project Revenue Dec 2018 YTD .xlsx',
                'Retirement Project Revenue Dec 2019 YTD .xlsx',
                'Retirement Project Revenue December YTD 2020.xlsx',
                'Retirement Project Revenue YTD 2021.xlsx',
                'Retirement Project Revenue YTD 2022.xlsx',
                'Retirement Project Revenue YTD 2023.xlsx',
                'Retirement Project Revenue YTD 2024.xlsx',
                'Retirement Project Revenue December YTD 2025.xlsx'
            )
                then try_cast(
                    substring(FiscalPeriodNumber, 1, 4) + '-' +
                    substring(FiscalPeriodNumber, 5, 2) + '-01'
                    as datetime2(6)
                )
            else FiscalPeriod
        end as FiscalPeriodFixed
    from mapped
),

-- Synthetic key fallback chain: natural id -> client name (the original Oracle fallback) ->
-- TX id (marked) -> row hash (marked). Guarantees SystemID/ClientID are never null.
keyed as (
    select
        *,
        cast(
            case
                when PrimaryCustomerAcctNo is not null
                     and PrimaryCustomerAcctNo <> ''
                     and PrimaryCustomerAcctNo <> '0'
                    then 'Oracle-' + PrimaryCustomerAcctNo
                when CustomerName is not null and ltrim(rtrim(CustomerName)) <> ''
                    then 'Oracle-' + CustomerName
                when ProjectNumber is not null and ProjectNumber <> ''
                    then 'Oracle-TX-' + ProjectNumber
                else 'Oracle-SYN-' + convert(varchar(64), hashbytes('SHA2_256',
                         concat(TwServiceOffering, '|', FiscalPeriodFixed, '|', RevenueAmount, '|', ProjectOfficeCode)), 2)
            end
            as varchar(500)
        )                                                                       as SystemIdCalc
    from fiscal_period_fixed
),

derived as (
    select
        cast(CustomerName as varchar(500))                                     as SystemClientName,
        cast(TwServiceOffering as varchar(255))                                as SystemProductClass,
        cast(ProjectNumber as varchar(150))                                    as TX_ID,
        FiscalPeriodFixed                                                      as IncomeInceptionDate,
        RevenueAmount                                                          as Revenue,
        cast(0.0 as decimal(18,2))                                             as Premium,
        SystemIdCalc                                                           as SystemID,
        cast(
            case
                when ltrim(rtrim(replace(EmployeeMarketCluster, 'Market', ''))) = 'India Consulting' then 'India'
                when replace(EmployeeMarketCluster, 'Market', '') = 'AP DATA MANAGEMENT CENTER' then 'Philippines'
                else replace(EmployeeMarketCluster, 'Market', '')
            end
            as varchar(100)
        )                                                                       as RevenueCountry,
        -- ClientID = GCID (from OracleID Mapping) -> synthetic SystemID chain
        cast(coalesce(nullif(Gcid, ''), SystemIdCalc) as varchar(500))         as ClientID,
        cast('Oracle' as varchar(50))                                          as DataSource,
        cast('RET'    as varchar(50))                                          as Segment,
        cast('Renewal' as varchar(50))                                         as BusinessType,
        cast('Y' as varchar(10))                                               as RecurringRevenue,
        cast(
            case
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'HKG1' then 'Hong Kong'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'PH$5' then 'Manila'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'MEL2' then 'Melbourne'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'BEI1' then 'Beijing'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'JPM2' then 'Osaka'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'SYD1' then 'Sydney'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'ISA1' then 'Mount Isa'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'THA1' then 'Bangkok'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'GUR3' then 'Gurgaon'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'BAN1' then 'Bangalore'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'KOL1' then 'Kolkata'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'SHA1' then 'Shanghai'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'MUM1' then 'Mumbai'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'TWN1' then 'Taipei'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'SKO1' then 'Seoul'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'SHE1' then 'Shenyang'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'SGP2' then 'Singapore'
                when ProjectOfficeCode = 'MLS2' then 'Kuala Lumpur'
                when ProjectOfficeCode in ('PHP4','PHP1','PHP2') then 'Manila'
                else null
            end
            as varchar(100)
        )                                                                       as RevenueCities,
        cast(DunsNo as varchar(50))                                            as DUNSNO,
        cast('USD' as varchar(10))                                             as Currency,
        cast(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(Gcid)), '') as varchar(50))                    as GCID,
        cast('Oracle' as varchar(50))                                          as [Source]
    from keyed

                when OperatingUnit = 'TW OU IN 3002-India Pvt'                                                          then 'India'

        )                                                                       as RevenueCountry,
        cast(
            case
                when OperatingUnit = 'TW OU HK 3022-Hong Kong'                                                          then 'HONG KONG'
                when OperatingUnit = 'TW OU TW 3121-Delaware Taiwan'                                                    then 'Taiwan'
                when OperatingUnit = 'TW OU CN 3241-Shanghai'                                                           then 'Shanghai'

model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__all_lobs.description: Faithful recreation of the og [All lobs_OS] + [All Lobs_O] queries (Fabric-Bronze/CRM/Copy_Os.sql + Copy_O.sql). OS path = income-assignment grain (Est Revenue = colleague share, falling back to line value); O path = opportunities with no active service line. og region rule (Asia/Australasia/India/Vietnam/China/ Australia/New Zealand vs region/subregion/territory) + christopher.au override. ALL business lines, full pipeline. og GROUP BY dropped (TagList pre-aggregated per opportunity instead). Baseline logic lives in int_crm__crm_baseline.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__all_lobs.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: CRM All-LOBs (faithful recreation of the og Copy_Os + Copy_O queries)
-- Sources: fabric-workspace/Fabric-Bronze/CRM/Copy_Os.sql ([All lobs_OS]) and Copy_O.sql ([All Lobs_O]),
--          rebuilt on the stg_crm__* models. UNION ALL of the two paths.
-- Output:  apac_crm_silver.int_crm__all_lobs (table, og column set)
-- Grain:   OS path = one row per income assignment (LEFT JOIN ia -- colleague-level; falls back to
--          the service line when no assignment). O path = one row per opportunity with NO active
--          service line (NOT EXISTS).
-- Scope:   og region rule -- ('Asia','Australasia','India','Vietnam','China','Australia','New Zealand')
--          against region/subregion/territory + the christopher.au override. ALL business lines,
--          full pipeline. Baseline logic (H&B filter, won-only, 606 phasing) lives in int_crm__crm_baseline.
-- Fabric Warehouse: EVERY string column is explicitly cast (even passthroughs) -- bare view-column
-- passthroughs infer nvarchar at CTAS and fail with error 24574.
-- Deviations from the og (deliberate):
--   * og GROUP BY dropped -- it existed for MAX(TagList)/SUM over single-row groups; TagList is
--     pre-aggregated per opportunity here, and per-row expressions replace the degenerate SUMs.
--     (Side effect: rows the og collapsed as fully-identical duplicates are kept.)

with os as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__opportunity_service') }}
),

o as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__opportunity') }}
),

a as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__account') }}
),

t as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__currency') }}
),

ia as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__income_assignment') }}
),

su as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__systemuser') }}
),

pc as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__profitcenter') }}
),

office as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__office') }}
),

-- og: tag list pre-aggregated per opportunity (one row per opportunity -- no fan-out)
tags as (
    select
        j.OpportunityId,
        cast(string_agg(tg.TagName, ' / ') as varchar(4000)) as TagList
    from {{ ref('stg_crm__opportunity_tagslist') }} j
    left join {{ ref('stg_crm__tagslist') }} tg
        on tg.TagId = j.TagId
    group by j.OpportunityId
),

-- ============ [All lobs_OS]: opportunities WITH service lines, income-assignment grain ============
os_path as (
    select
        cast(a.DunsNumber as varchar(50))                                      as DunsNumber,
        cast(o.OriginatingLeadId as varchar(50))                               as OriginatingLeadID,
        cast(o.OpportunityId as varchar(50))                                   as GUID,
        cast(o.OpportunityNumber as varchar(50))                               as OpptyID,
        cast(os.OpportunityName as varchar(500))                               as OpptySummary,
        cast(o.PipelinePhase as varchar(255))                                  as [Pipeline Phase],
        cast(o.Description as varchar(max))                                    as Description,
        cast(o.FormName as varchar(255))                                       as FormName,
        cast(os.LobName as varchar(255))                                       as ProductClass,
        cast(os.ServiceName as varchar(255))                                   as ProductSubClass,
        cast(coalesce(o.FrequencyName, os.FrequencyName) as varchar(100))      as Frequency,
        cast(o.StatusCodeName as varchar(100))                                 as OpptyStatus,
        cast(o.StateCodeName as varchar(100))                                  as OpptyState,
        cast(o.OpportunityTypeName as varchar(100))                            as OpptyType,
        cast(coalesce(o.OpportunitySubTypeName, o.OpportunityTypeName) as varchar(100)) as OpptySubType,
        cast(coalesce(ia.ShareAmount, os.LineValue) as decimal(18,2))          as [Est. Revenue (LCY)],
        cast(coalesce(ia.ShareAmountBase, os.LineValueBase) as decimal(18,2))  as [Est. Revenue (USD)],
        -- upper(): Fabric Warehouse default collation is BIN2 (case-sensitive); D365 value is 'Won'
        cast(
            case
                when upper(o.StateCodeName) = 'WON'
                    then coalesce(ia.ShareAmount, os.LineValue, 0)
                else coalesce(ia.ShareAmount, os.LineValue, 0)
                     * (try_cast(replace(o.ProbabilityName, '%', '') as float) / 100.0)
            end
            as decimal(18,2)
        )                                                                       as [Wt. Revenue (LCY)],
        cast(
            case
                when upper(o.StateCodeName) = 'WON'
                    then coalesce(ia.ShareAmountBase, os.LineValueBase, 0)
                else coalesce(ia.ShareAmountBase, os.LineValueBase, 0)
                     * (try_cast(replace(o.ProbabilityName, '%', '') as float) / 100.0)
            end
            as decimal(18,2)
        )                                                                       as [Wt. Revenue (USD)],
        cast(t.IsoCurrencyCode as varchar(10))                                 as CCY,
        cast(o.ProbabilityName as varchar(50))                                 as [Likelihood of Win],
        cast(o.PremiumBase as decimal(18,2))                                   as [Premium (USD)],
        cast(o.ProjectStartDate as date)                                       as [Project Start Date],
        cast(o.LatestModifiedDate as date)                                     as ModifiedOn,
        cast(o.CreatedOn as datetime2(6))                                      as CreatedOn,
        cast(o.ActualCloseDate as date)                                        as CloseDate,
        cast(coalesce(o.CampaignName, 'Not Informed') as varchar(255))         as [Source Campaign],
        cast(o.ParentAccountName as varchar(500))                              as Account,
        cast(a.ParentAccountName as varchar(500))                              as [Parent Account],
        cast(a.GlobalParentAccountName as varchar(500))                        as [Global Parent Account],
        cast(a.AccountNumber as varchar(100))                                  as GCID,
        cast(a.ClientSegmentation as varchar(255))                             as Tiers,
        cast(coalesce(office.SubRegionName, s.TerritoryName) as varchar(255))  as [Service Region],
        cast(coalesce(os.OfficeName, s.OfficeName) as varchar(255))            as [Service Office],
        cast(coalesce(office.Country, s.Country) as varchar(255))              as [Service Office Country],
        cast(coalesce(ia.ProfitCenterName, s.ProfitCenterName, o.OwnerName) as varchar(500)) as [Profit Center],
        cast(coalesce(pc.FinanceLevelName, office.Country, s.Country) as varchar(255)) as [Finance Level],
        cast(o.OwnerName as varchar(500))                                      as [Opportunity Owner],
        cast(s1.DomainName as varchar(500))                                    as [Opportunity Owner UPN],
        cast(coalesce(ia.ColleagueName, s.FullName, o.OwnerName) as varchar(500)) as [Colleague Involved],
        cast(coalesce(s.OfficeName, os.OfficeName) as varchar(255))            as [Colleague Involved Office],
        cast(s.DomainName as varchar(500))                                     as [Colleague Involved UPN],
        cast(s1.ProfitCenterName as varchar(500))                              as OwnerProfitCenter,
        cast(tags.TagList as varchar(4000))                                    as TagList,
        cast(o.InceptionDate as date)                                          as [First Income Date],
        cast(a.IndustryName as varchar(255))                                   as [Industry (Account Name) (Account)],
        cast(a.PrimarySicCode as varchar(255))                                 as [Primary SIC Code (Account Name)(Account)],
        cast(a.Country as varchar(255))                                        as [Country (Account Name)(Account)],
        cast('Opportunity Service' as varchar(50))                             as [Data Version]
    from os
    inner join o
        on os.OpportunityId = o.OpportunityId
    left join a
        on o.ParentAccountId = a.AccountId
    left join t
        on os.TransactionCurrencyId = t.CurrencyId
    left join ia
        on os.OpportunityServiceId = ia.ServiceLineId
    left join su s
        on ia.ColleagueId = s.SystemUserId
    left join su s1
        on o.OwnerId = s1.SystemUserId
    left join pc
        on ia.ProfitCenterId = pc.ProfitCenterId
    left join office
        on office.OfficeId = os.OfficeId
    left join tags
        on tags.OpportunityId = o.OpportunityId
    where (
            (
                -- og order: office subregion first, then colleague territory, then opportunity region
                coalesce(office.SubRegionName, s.TerritoryName, o.RegionName)
                    in ('Asia', 'Australasia', 'India', 'Vietnam', 'China', 'Australia', 'New Zealand')
                and o.StatusCodeName <> 'Duplicate Entry'
                and os.StateCode = 0
                and (ia.StateCode = 0 or ia.StateCode is null)
            )
            or s1.DomainName = 'christopher.au@willistowerswatson.com'
            or s.DomainName = 'christopher.au@willistowerswatson.com'
        )
),

-- ============ [All Lobs_O]: opportunities with NO active service line ============
o_path as (
    select
        cast(a.DunsNumber as varchar(50))                                      as DunsNumber,
        cast(o.OriginatingLeadId as varchar(50))                               as OriginatingLeadID,
        cast(o.OpportunityId as varchar(50))                                   as GUID,
        cast(o.OpportunityNumber as varchar(50))                               as OpptyID,
        cast(o.OpportunityName as varchar(500))                                as OpptySummary,
        cast(o.PipelinePhase as varchar(255))                                  as [Pipeline Phase],
        cast(o.Description as varchar(max))                                    as Description,
        cast(o.FormName as varchar(255))                                       as FormName,
        cast(o.ProductClassName as varchar(255))                               as ProductClass,
        cast(o.ProductSubClassName as varchar(255))                            as ProductSubClass,
        cast(o.FrequencyName as varchar(100))                                  as Frequency,
        cast(o.StatusCodeName as varchar(100))                                 as OpptyStatus,
        cast(o.StateCodeName as varchar(100))                                  as OpptyState,
        cast(o.OpportunityTypeName as varchar(100))                            as OpptyType,
        cast(coalesce(o.OpportunitySubTypeName, o.OpportunityTypeName) as varchar(100)) as OpptySubType,
        cast(o.EstimatedValue as decimal(18,2))                                as [Est. Revenue (LCY)],
        cast(o.EstimatedValueBase as decimal(18,2))                            as [Est. Revenue (USD)],
        cast(o.WeightedIncome as decimal(18,2))                                as [Wt. Revenue (LCY)],
        cast(o.WeightedIncomeBase as decimal(18,2))                            as [Wt. Revenue (USD)],
        cast(t.IsoCurrencyCode as varchar(10))                                 as CCY,
        cast(o.ProbabilityName as varchar(50))                                 as [Likelihood of Win],
        cast(o.PremiumBase as decimal(18,2))                                   as [Premium (USD)],
        cast(o.ProjectStartDate as date)                                       as [Project Start Date],
        cast(o.LatestModifiedDate as date)                                     as ModifiedOn,
        cast(o.CreatedOn as datetime2(6))                                      as CreatedOn,
        cast(o.ActualCloseDate as date)                                        as CloseDate,
        cast(coalesce(o.CampaignName, 'Not Informed') as varchar(255))         as [Source Campaign],
        cast(o.ParentAccountName as varchar(500))                              as Account,
        cast(a.ParentAccountName as varchar(500))                              as [Parent Account],
        cast(a.GlobalParentAccountName as varchar(500))                        as [Global Parent Account],
        cast(a.AccountNumber as varchar(100))                                  as GCID,
        cast(a.ClientSegmentation as varchar(255))                             as Tiers,
        cast(coalesce(o.RegionName, s.TerritoryName) as varchar(255))          as [Service Region],
        cast(coalesce(o.OfficeName, s.OfficeName) as varchar(255))             as [Service Office],
        cast(coalesce(office.Country, s.Country) as varchar(255))              as [Service Office Country],
        cast(coalesce(o.ProfitCenterName, s.ProfitCenterName, o.OwnerName) as varchar(500)) as [Profit Center],
        cast(o.FinanceLevel1Name as varchar(255))                              as [Finance Level],
        cast(o.OwnerName as varchar(500))                                      as [Opportunity Owner],
        cast(s1.DomainName as varchar(500))                                    as [Opportunity Owner UPN],
        cast(o.OwnerName as varchar(500))                                      as [Colleague Involved],
        cast(coalesce(s.OfficeName, o.OfficeName) as varchar(255))             as [Colleague Involved Office],
        cast(s.DomainName as varchar(500))                                     as [Colleague Involved UPN],
        cast(s.ProfitCenterName as varchar(500))                               as OwnerProfitCenter,
        cast(tags.TagList as varchar(4000))                                    as TagList,
        cast(o.InceptionDate as date)                                          as [First Income Date],
        cast(a.IndustryName as varchar(255))                                   as [Industry (Account Name) (Account)],
        cast(a.PrimarySicCode as varchar(255))                                 as [Primary SIC Code (Account Name)(Account)],
        cast(a.Country as varchar(255))                                        as [Country (Account Name)(Account)],
        cast('Non Opportunity Service' as varchar(50))                         as [Data Version]
    from o
    left join a
        on o.ParentAccountId = a.AccountId
    left join su s
        on o.OwnerId = s.SystemUserId
    left join su s1
        on o.OwnerId = s1.SystemUserId
    left join office
        on office.OfficeId = o.OfficeId
    left join t
        on o.TransactionCurrencyId = t.CurrencyId
    left join tags
        on tags.OpportunityId = o.OpportunityId
    where o.StatusCodeName <> 'Duplicate Entry'
      and (
            (
                o.RegionName in ('Asia', 'Australasia', 'India', 'Vietnam', 'China', 'Australia', 'New Zealand')
                or office.SubRegionName in ('Asia', 'Australasia', 'India', 'Vietnam', 'China', 'Australia', 'New Zealand')
                or s.TerritoryName in ('Asia', 'Australasia', 'India', 'Vietnam', 'China', 'Australia', 'New Zealand')
            )
            or s.DomainName = 'christopher.au@willistowerswatson.com'
        )
      and not exists (
            select 1
            from os
            where os.OpportunityId = o.OpportunityId
              and os.StateCode = 0
        )
)

H&B branch: won-only + 12-month revenue phasing for the 5 '606' countries + 4 H&B sub-classes. model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__crm_baseli.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: CRM baseline (H&B All-LOBs + rest-of-HWC, baseline-specific)
-- Sources: int_crm__all_lobs (H&B branch) + int_crm__hwc_income_assignment (og-recreation, wide)
-- Output:  apac_crm_silver.int_crm__crm_baseline (table)
-- Grain:   one row per H&B opportunity/service (x12 for monthly-phased rows) + one per HWC income
--          assignment (x phasing period when Custom).
-- This model IS the legacy M layer -- all baseline business logic lives here, on top of the
-- reusable int models:
--   H&B:  ProductSubClass like 'H&B%', won-only, 12-month phasing for the 5 "606" countries
--         + 4 specific H&B sub-classes (Est Revenue / 12). NO date cutoff (matches the M).
--   HWC:  explicit 21-LOB list (no H&B / no RET), won-only, W&R-with-project-dates -> phased
--         [DATE] snapped to month start (else First Income Date),
--         cutoff IncomeInceptionDate > 2023-01-01 (CIS historical covers < 2023-01-01)
--   Both: BusinessType -> 'NEW BUSINESS' normalisation + RecurringRevenue Y/N
-- CIS historical is NOT here -- it joins the mart UNION as its own source.
-- Replaces the legacy combined baseline_CRM_* Power Query.

with all_lobs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_crm__all_lobs') }}
),

hb as (
    select
        Account,
        ProductSubClass,
        OpptyID,
        GUID,
        GCID,
        OpptyType,
        OpptyState,
        DunsNumber,
        [Est. Revenue (USD)]       as EstRevenueUsd,
        [Premium (USD)]            as PremiumUsd,
        [Service Office]           as ServiceOffice,
        [Service Office Country]   as ServiceOfficeCountry,
        [First Income Date]        as FirstIncomeDate,
        case
            when upper([Service Office Country]) in ('JAPAN', 'MALAYSIA', 'SOUTH KOREA', 'THAILAND', 'VIETNAM')
                 and ProductSubClass in (
                     'H&B: Advisory / Consulting / Benchmarking / Strategy',
                     'H&B: Brokerage (incl. Plan Mgmt & Ongoing Consulting)',
                     'H&B: Expat Benefits (incl. IPMI)',
                     'H&B: Group Medical'
                 )
                then 1
            else 0
        end as IsMonthly
    from all_lobs
    where ProductSubClass like 'H&B%'
      -- M null semantics: null <> "Lost" is TRUE in Power Query -- keep null-state rows
      and (OpptyState <> 'Lost' or OpptyState is null)
      and [Likelihood of Win] = '100%'
),

-- 0..11 month offsets. Fabric Warehouse does NOT support the multi-row VALUES table
-- constructor, so this is a UNION ALL list.
months as (
    select value as n
    from generate_series(0, 11)
),

-- monthly-phased H&B: 12 rows, Est Revenue spread evenly across months from First Income Date
monthly as (
    select
        hb.Account,
        hb.ProductSubClass,
        hb.OpptyID,
        cast(dateadd(month, m.n, hb.FirstIncomeDate) as datetime2(6))  as IncomeDateCalc,
        cast(hb.EstRevenueUsd / 12 as decimal(18,2))                   as RevenueCalc,
        hb.PremiumUsd,
        hb.GUID,
        hb.ServiceOfficeCountry,
        hb.GCID,
        hb.OpptyType,
        hb.ServiceOffice,
        hb.DunsNumber,
        hb.OpptyState
    from hb
    cross join months m
    where hb.IsMonthly = 1
),

-- everything else: single row, full Est Revenue at First Income Date
single as (
    select
        hb.Account,
        hb.ProductSubClass,
        hb.OpptyID,
        cast(hb.FirstIncomeDate as datetime2(6))                       as IncomeDateCalc,
        cast(hb.EstRevenueUsd as decimal(18,2))                        as RevenueCalc,
        hb.PremiumUsd,
        hb.GUID,
        hb.ServiceOfficeCountry,
        hb.GCID,
        hb.OpptyType,
        hb.ServiceOffice,
        hb.DunsNumber,
        hb.OpptyState
    from hb
    where hb.IsMonthly = 0
),

hb_calc as (
    select * from monthly
    union all
    select * from single
),

hb_all as (
    select
        cast(Account as varchar(500))                          as SystemClientName,
        cast(ProductSubClass as varchar(255))                  as SystemProductClass,
        cast(OpptyID as varchar(150))                          as TX_ID,
        cast(IncomeDateCalc as datetime2(6))                   as IncomeInceptionDate,
        cast(RevenueCalc as decimal(18,2))                     as Revenue,
        cast(coalesce(PremiumUsd, 0.0) as decimal(18,2))       as Premium,
        cast(GUID as varchar(150))                             as SystemID,
        cast(ServiceOfficeCountry as varchar(50))              as RevenueCountry,
        cast(coalesce(nullif(GCID, ''), GUID) as varchar(150)) as ClientID,
        cast('CRM' as varchar(50))                             as DataSource,
        cast('H&B' as varchar(50))                             as Segment,
        cast(OpptyType as varchar(50))                         as BusinessType,
        cast('' as varchar(10))                                 as RecurringRevenue,
        cast(ServiceOffice as varchar(100))                    as RevenueCities,
        cast(DunsNumber as varchar(50))                        as DUNSNO,
        cast('USD' as varchar(10))                             as Currency,
        cast(GCID as varchar(50))                              as GCID,
        cast('HWC_CRM' as varchar(50))                         as [Source],
        cast(null as varchar(255))                             as [SubProduct/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255))                             as [Product/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255))                             as SystemProductClass2,
        cast(OpptyState as varchar(50))                        as OpptyState
    from hb_calc
),

-- ============ HWC branch: the legacy M baseline logic, applied to the og-recreation table ============

-- M "Filtered rows": explicit LOB list (no H&B -- all_lobs covers it; no RET -- Oracle RET covers it),
-- then won-only.
hwc_filtered as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_crm__hwc_income_assignment') }}
    where ProductClass in (
        'Employee Experience',
        'EX: Advisory',
        'EX: Product',
        'ICT: Life Insurance',
        'ICT: Life Products',
        'ICT: PC Insurance',
        'ICT: PC Products',
        'INV: Advisory',
        'INV: Asset Management Service',
        'INV: Conference',
        'INV: Software',
        'INV: Specialist Portfolio Solution',
        'INV: Thinking Ahead Institute',
        'INV: Total Fund Solution',
        'INV: Wealth Management',
        'W&R: ECBA',
        'W&R: RDI - CDA',
        'W&R: RDI - Product',
        'W&R: RDI - Software',
        'W&R: WRC',
        'Work & Rewards'
    )
      -- M null semantics: null <> "Lost" is TRUE in Power Query -- keep null-state rows
      and (OpptyState <> 'Lost' or OpptyState is null)
      and [Likelihood of Win] = '100%'
),

-- M shaping: derive columns, conform to the 22-column baseline schema.
-- IncomeDate rule: W&R rows with BOTH project dates -> the phased [DATE] snapped to start of month;
-- everything else -> [First Income Date].
hwc_shaped as (
    select
        cast(Account as varchar(500))                          as SystemClientName,
        cast(ProductClass as varchar(255))                     as SystemProductClass,
        cast(OpptyID as varchar(150))                          as TX_ID,
        cast(
            case
                when upper(ProductClass) like 'W&R%'
                     and [Project Start Date] is not null
                     and [Project end Date] is not null
                    then datefromparts(year([DATE]), month([DATE]), 1)
                else cast([First Income Date] as datetime2(6))
            end
            as datetime2(6)
        )                                                       as IncomeInceptionDate,
        cast(Revenue as decimal(18,2))                         as Revenue,
        -- M types Premium without a null->0 default (unlike the H&B branch) -- keep nulls
        cast([Premium (USD)] as decimal(18,2))                 as Premium,
        cast(GUID as varchar(150))                             as SystemID,
        cast([Service Office Country] as varchar(50))          as RevenueCountry,
        cast(coalesce(nullif(GCID, ''), GUID) as varchar(150)) as ClientID,
        cast('CRM' as varchar(50))                             as DataSource,
        cast(
            case
                when upper(ProductClass) like 'ICT%'                  then 'ICT'
                when upper(ProductClass) like 'EX%'                   then 'EX'
                when upper(ProductClass) like 'INV%'                  then 'INV'
                when upper(ProductClass) like 'W&R%'                  then 'W&R'
                when upper(ProductClass) like 'RET%'                  then 'RET'
                when upper(ProductClass) like '%INVESTMENTS%'         then 'INV'
                when upper(ProductClass) like '%EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE%' then 'EX'
                when upper(ProductClass) = 'RETIREMENT'               then 'RET'
                when upper(ProductClass) = 'WORK & REWARDS'           then 'W&R'
                else ''
            end
            as varchar(50)
        )                                                       as Segment,
        cast(OpptyType as varchar(50))                         as BusinessType,
        cast('' as varchar(10))                                 as RecurringRevenue,
        cast([Service Office] as varchar(100))                 as RevenueCities,
        cast(DunsNumber as varchar(50))                        as DUNSNO,
        cast('USD' as varchar(10))                             as Currency,
        cast(GCID as varchar(50))                              as GCID,
        cast('HWC_CRM' as varchar(50))                         as [Source],
        cast(null as varchar(255))                             as [SubProduct/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255))                             as [Product/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255))                             as SystemProductClass2,
        -- M drops OpptyState before the append -- legacy HWC rows carry NULL (only H&B keeps it)
        cast(null as varchar(50))                              as OpptyState
    from hwc_filtered
),

-- M Filter_DateRange: CIS historical supplies WR+EX+ICT+INV before 2023.
hwc_cut as (
    select * from hwc_shaped
    where IncomeInceptionDate > cast('2023-01-01' as datetime2(6))
),

crm_raw as (
    select * from hb_all
    union all
    select * from hwc_cut
),

-- normalise BusinessType across both branches (NEW-NEW / NEW FROM EXISTING / CROSS SELL -> NEW BUSINESS)
bt_normalised as (
    select
        SystemClientName, SystemProductClass, TX_ID, IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue, Premium, SystemID, RevenueCountry, ClientID,
        DataSource, Segment,
        cast(
            case
                when BusinessType in ('NEW-NEW', 'NEW FROM EXISTING', 'CROSS SELL') then 'NEW BUSINESS'
                else BusinessType
            end
            as varchar(50)
        )                                                       as BusinessType,
        RecurringRevenue,
        RevenueCities, DUNSNO, Currency, GCID, [Source],
        [SubProduct/Service], [Product/Service], SystemProductClass2, OpptyState
    from crm_raw
),

final as (
    select
        SystemClientName, SystemProductClass, TX_ID, IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue, Premium, SystemID, RevenueCountry, ClientID,
        DataSource, Segment, BusinessType,
        -- derive RecurringRevenue from the normalised BusinessType
        cast(
            case when BusinessType in ('NEW BUSINESS', 'RENEWAL') then 'Y' else 'N' end
            as varchar(10)
        )                                                       as RecurringRevenue,
        RevenueCities, DUNSNO, Currency, GCID, [Source],
        [SubProduct/Service], [Product/Service], SystemProductClass2, OpptyState
    from bt_normalised
)

select * from final

model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__hwc_income.name: int_crm__hwc_income_assignment
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__hwc_income.description: Faithful recreation of the original HWC income assignment SQL (Fabric-Bronze/CRM/hwc_incomeAssignment.sql) -- the wide og column set, replacing the legacy _HWC_IncomeAssignment table. og scope: Active IA, APAC subregions, all six businesses (H&B/W&R/EX/ICT/INV/RET). TagList + GROUP BY dropped (agreed). Baseline business logic (21-LOB list, won-only, date rules, > 2023-01-01 cutoff) lives in int_crm__crm_baseline. Grain: one row per income assignment, one per phasing period when Phase Type='Custom'.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__hwc_income.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: HWC Income Assignment (faithful recreation of the original D365 SQL)
-- Source:  fabric-workspace/Fabric-Bronze/CRM/hwc_incomeAssignment.sql (the og query),
--          rebuilt on the stg_crm__* models. Replaces the legacy _HWC_IncomeAssignment table.
-- Output:  apac_crm_silver.int_crm__hwc_income_assignment (table, WIDE og column set)
-- Grain:   one row per income assignment; one row per phasing period when PhaseTypeName='Custom'.
-- Scope:   og WHERE -- Active IA, APAC subregions, ALL six businesses (H&B/W&R/EX/ICT/INV/RET).
--          Baseline business logic (21-LOB list, won-only, date rules, > 2023-01-01) is NOT here --
--          it lives in int_crm__crm_baseline, mirroring the legacy M layer.
-- Fabric Warehouse: EVERY string column is explicitly cast (even passthroughs) -- bare view-column
-- passthroughs infer nvarchar at CTAS and fail with error 24574.
-- Deviations from the og (agreed):
--   * TagList (STRING_AGG) + tag joins + the GROUP BY dropped -- TagList not needed; the GROUP BY
--     existed only for the aggregation.

with ia as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__income_assignment') }}
    where StateCode = 0   -- og: ia.statecodename = 'Active'
),

iap as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__income_assignment_phasing') }}
),

os as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__opportunity_service') }}
),

pd as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__productclass') }}
),

s as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__systemuser') }}
),

pc as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__profitcenter') }}
),

office as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__office') }}
),

o as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__opportunity') }}
),

a as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__account') }}
),

t as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__currency') }}
)

select
    cast(a.DunsNumber as varchar(50))                                      as DunsNumber,
    cast(os.OpportunityServiceId as varchar(50))                           as GUID,
    cast(o.OpportunityNumber as varchar(50))                               as OpptyID,
    cast(os.OpportunityName as varchar(500))                               as OpptySummary,
    cast(os.LobName as varchar(255))                                       as [LOBs],
    cast(o.PipelinePhase as varchar(255))                                  as [Pipeline Phase],
    cast(o.Description as varchar(max))                                    as Description,
    cast(o.FormName as varchar(255))                                       as FormName,
    cast(os.LobName as varchar(255))                                       as ProductClass,
    cast(os.ServiceName as varchar(255))                                   as ProductSubClass,
    cast(o.FrequencyName as varchar(100))                                  as Frequency,
    cast(os.FrequencyName as varchar(100))                                 as ServiceFrequency,
    cast(os.RevenueTypeName as varchar(100))                               as [Service Revenue Type],
    cast(o.StatusCodeName as varchar(100))                                 as OpptyStatus,
    cast(o.StateCodeName as varchar(100))                                  as OpptyState,
    cast(o.OpportunityTypeName as varchar(100))                            as OpptyType,
    cast(coalesce(o.OpportunitySubTypeName, o.OpportunityTypeName) as varchar(100)) as OpptySubType,
    cast(iap.Amount as decimal(18,2))                                      as rs_amount,
    cast(iap.AmountBase as decimal(18,2))                                  as rs_amount_base,
    cast(os.LineValue as decimal(18,2))                                    as [Line Value (LCY)],
    cast(os.LineValueBase as decimal(18,2))                                as [Line Value (USD)],
    cast(o.EstimatedValue as decimal(18,2))                                as [Total Contracted Value  (LCY)],
    cast(o.EstimatedValueBase as decimal(18,2))                            as [Total Contracted Value (USD)],
    cast(os.LineValue     * (try_cast(replace(o.ProbabilityName, '%', '') as int) / 100.0) as decimal(18,2)) as [Wt. Revenue (LCY)],
    cast(os.LineValueBase * (try_cast(replace(o.ProbabilityName, '%', '') as int) / 100.0) as decimal(18,2)) as [Wt. Revenue (USD)],
    cast(t.IsoCurrencyCode as varchar(10))                                 as CCY,
    cast(o.ProbabilityName as varchar(50))                                 as [Likelihood of Win],
    cast(o.PremiumBase as decimal(18,2))                                   as [Premium (USD)],
    cast(o.ProjectStartDate as date)                                       as [Project Start Date],
    cast(o.ProjectEndDate as date)                                         as [Project end Date],
    cast(o.LatestModifiedDate as date)                                     as ModifiedOn,
    cast(o.CreatedOn as datetime2(6))                                      as CreatedOn,
    cast(o.ActualCloseDate as date)                                        as CloseDate,
    cast(coalesce(o.CampaignName, 'Not Informed') as varchar(255))         as [Source Campaign],
    cast(o.ParentAccountName as varchar(500))                              as Account,
    cast(a.ParentAccountName as varchar(500))                              as [Parent Account],
    cast(a.GlobalParentAccountName as varchar(500))                        as [Global Parent Account],
    cast(a.AccountNumber as varchar(100))                                  as GCID,
    cast(a.ClientSegmentation as varchar(255))                             as Tiers,
    cast(coalesce(office.RegionName, s.TerritoryName) as varchar(255))     as [Service Region],
    cast(coalesce(os.OfficeName, s.OfficeName) as varchar(255))            as [Service Office],
    cast(coalesce(office.Country, s.Country) as varchar(255))              as [Service Office Country],
    cast(coalesce(ia.ProfitCenterName, s.ProfitCenterName, o.OwnerName) as varchar(500)) as [Profit Center],
    cast(pc.FinanceLevelName as varchar(255))                              as [Finance Level],
    cast(o.OwnerName as varchar(500))                                      as [Opportunity Owner],
    cast(coalesce(ia.ColleagueName, s.FullName, o.OwnerName) as varchar(500)) as [Colleague Involved],
    cast(s.OfficeName as varchar(255))                                     as [Colleague Involved Office],
    cast(s.DomainName as varchar(500))                                     as [Colleague Involved UPN],
    cast(o.InceptionDate as date)                                          as [First Income Date],
    cast(a.IndustryName as varchar(255))                                   as [Industry (Account Name) (Account)],
    cast(a.PrimarySicCode as varchar(255))                                 as [Primary SIC Code (Account Name)(Account)],
    cast(a.Country as varchar(255))                                        as [Country (Account Name)(Account)],
    cast(ia.PhaseTypeName as varchar(100))                                 as [Phase Type],
    cast(
        case
            when ia.PhaseTypeName = 'Custom' and iap.PhasingDate is not null then iap.PhasingDate
            when ia.PhaseTypeName = 'Custom' and iap.PhasingDate is null then cast(o.InceptionDate as datetime2(6))
            else cast(o.InceptionDate as datetime2(6))
        end
        as datetime2(6)
    )                                                                       as [DATE],
    cast(
        case
            when ia.PhaseTypeName = 'Custom' and iap.AmountBase is not null
                then iap.AmountBase * (try_cast(replace(o.ProbabilityName, '%', '') as int) / 100.0)
            when ia.PhaseTypeName = 'Custom' and iap.AmountBase is null
                then ia.ShareAmountBase * (try_cast(replace(o.ProbabilityName, '%', '') as int) / 100.0)
            else ia.ShareAmountBase * (try_cast(replace(o.ProbabilityName, '%', '') as int) / 100.0)
        end
        as decimal(18,2)
    )                                                                       as Revenue,
    cast(ia.ExchangeRate as decimal(18,6))                                 as Exchangerate,
    cast(
        case
            when ia.PhaseTypeName = 'Annual' and ia.NoOfYears is not null then ia.NoOfYears
            else 0
        end
        as int
    )                                                                       as OfYears
from ia
left join iap
    on ia.IncomeAssignmentId = iap.IncomeAssignmentId
   and ia.PhaseTypeName = 'Custom'
left join os
    on ia.ServiceLineId = os.OpportunityServiceId
left join pd
    on pd.ProductClassId = os.LobId
left join s
    on ia.ColleagueId = s.SystemUserId
left join pc
    on s.ProfitCenterId = pc.ProfitCenterId
left join office
    on office.OfficeId = os.OfficeId
left join o
    on os.OpportunityId = o.OpportunityId
left join a
    on o.ParentAccountId = a.AccountId
left join t
    on os.TransactionCurrencyId = t.CurrencyId
where o.StatusCodeName <> 'Duplicate Entry'
  and office.SubRegionName in ('Asia', 'Australasia', 'LATAM', 'CEEMEA', 'Latin America')
  and pd.BusinessName in ('H&B', 'W&R', 'EX', 'ICT', 'INV', 'RET')

model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__pipeline_b.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: pipeline base = current D365 all-LOBs + Legacy CIS historical (rows not already
-- present by OpptyID). Both in the All-LOBs column shape; the 9 D365-only fields CIS lacks are
-- null-filled. This is the enrichment input for int_crm__pipeline_enriched, so the mapping applies
-- uniformly to D365 + CIS. int_crm__all_lobs is left untouched (it feeds the billing baseline).
-- CIS rows have no systemuserid -- they resolve worker Business via Colleague Involved UPN only.
--
-- RENAME BOUNDARY: all_lobs carries the legacy bracketed names (billing contract). This model is the
-- single place we translate them to the canonical PascalCase vocabulary shared by pipeline_enriched and
-- the gold facts (ID suffixes upper-case: OpptyID / OriginatingLeadID / GUID). See _crm__column_lineage.md.

with all_lobs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_crm__all_lobs') }}
),

cis as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__historical') }}
),

-- CIS rows not in the current D365 pull (anti-join on OpptyID), APAC-filtered to match NB1's
-- combined-set region filter (Service_Region in Asia / Australasia / Vietnam / India / China).
-- all_lobs is already region-filtered upstream; this aligns the CIS half.
cis_only as (
    select c.*
    from cis c
    where not exists (
        select 1 from all_lobs a
        where trim(a.OpptyID) = trim(c.OpptyID)
    )
    and upper(trim(c.ServiceRegion)) in ('ASIA', 'AUSTRALASIA', 'VIETNAM', 'INDIA', 'CHINA')
),

-- align CIS to the int_crm__all_lobs column set (same order); null-fill D365-only fields
cis_aligned as (
    select
        cast(null as varchar(50))      as DunsNumber,
        cast(null as varchar(50))      as OriginatingLeadID,
        GUID                           as GUID,
        OpptyID                        as OpptyID,
        OpptyName                      as OpptySummary,
        PipelinePhase                  as [Pipeline Phase],
        Description                    as Description,
        FormName                       as FormName,
        ProductClass                   as ProductClass,
        ProductSubClass                as ProductSubClass,
        Frequency                      as Frequency,
        OpptyStatus                    as OpptyStatus,
        OpptyState                     as OpptyState,
        OpptyType                      as OpptyType,
        OpptySubType                   as OpptySubType,
        EstRevenueLCY                  as [Est. Revenue (LCY)],
        EstRevenueUSD                  as [Est. Revenue (USD)],
        WtRevenueLCY                   as [Wt. Revenue (LCY)],
        WtRevenueUSD                   as [Wt. Revenue (USD)],
        CCY                            as CCY,
        LikelihoodOfWin                as [Likelihood of Win],
        cast(null as decimal(18,2))    as [Premium (USD)],
        cast(null as date)             as [Project Start Date],
        cast(null as date)             as ModifiedOn,
        cast(null as datetime2(6))     as CreatedOn,
        CloseDate                      as CloseDate,
        SourceCampaign                 as [Source Campaign],
        Account                        as Account,
        ParentAccount                  as [Parent Account],
        GlobalParentAccount            as [Global Parent Account],
        GCID                           as GCID,
        Tiers                          as Tiers,
        ServiceRegion                  as [Service Region],
        ServiceOffice                  as [Service Office],
        ServiceOfficeCountry           as [Service Office Country],
        ProfitCenter                   as [Profit Center],
        FinanceLevel                   as [Finance Level],
        OpportunityOwner               as [Opportunity Owner],
        cast(null as varchar(500))     as [Opportunity Owner UPN],
        ColleagueInvolved              as [Colleague Involved],
        cast(null as varchar(255))     as [Colleague Involved Office],
        ColleagueInvolvedUpn           as [Colleague Involved UPN],
        cast(null as varchar(500))     as OwnerProfitCenter,
        TagList                        as TagList,
        FirstIncomeDate                as [First Income Date],
        Industry                       as [Industry (Account Name) (Account)],
        PrimarySicCode                 as [Primary SIC Code (Account Name)(Account)],
        AccountCountry                 as [Country (Account Name)(Account)],
        DataVersion                    as [Data Version]
    from cis_only
),

-- union the two halves in the legacy bracketed shape, then rename once to the canonical vocabulary
unioned as (
    select * from all_lobs
    union all
    select * from cis_aligned
)

select
    DunsNumber,
    OriginatingLeadID,
    GUID,
    OpptyID,
    OpptySummary                               as OpptyName,
    [Pipeline Phase]                           as PipelinePhase,
    Description,
    FormName,
    ProductClass,
    ProductSubClass,
    Frequency,
    OpptyStatus,
    OpptyState,
    OpptyType,
    OpptySubType,
    [Est. Revenue (LCY)]                       as EstRevenueLCY,
    [Est. Revenue (USD)]                       as EstRevenueUSD,
    [Wt. Revenue (LCY)]                        as WtRevenueLCY,
    [Wt. Revenue (USD)]                        as WtRevenueUSD,
    CCY                                        as CCY,
    [Likelihood of Win]                        as LikelihoodOfWin,
    [Premium (USD)]                            as PremiumUSD,
    [Project Start Date]                       as ProjectStartDate,
    ModifiedOn,
    CreatedOn,
    CloseDate,
    [Source Campaign]                          as SourceCampaign,
    Account,
    [Parent Account]                           as ParentAccount,
    [Global Parent Account]                    as GlobalParentAccount,
    GCID,
    Tiers,
    [Service Region]                           as ServiceRegion,
    [Service Office]                           as ServiceOffice,
    [Service Office Country]                   as ServiceOfficeCountry,
    [Profit Center]                            as ProfitCenter,
    [Finance Level]                            as FinanceLevel,
    [Opportunity Owner]                        as OpportunityOwner,
    [Opportunity Owner UPN]                    as OpportunityOwnerUpn,
    [Colleague Involved]                       as Owner,
    [Colleague Involved Office]                as ColleagueInvolvedOffice,
    [Colleague Involved UPN]                   as ColleagueInvolvedUpn,
    OwnerProfitCenter,
    TagList,
    [First Income Date]                        as FirstIncomeDate,
    [Industry (Account Name) (Account)]        as Industry,
    [Primary SIC Code (Account Name)(Account)] as PrimarySicCode,
    [Country (Account Name)(Account)]          as AccountCountry,
    [Data Version]                             as DataVersion
from unioned
