model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__pipeline_e.description: Canonical PascalCase APAC sales pipeline (all businesses). NB1 Batch-3 port over the three enriched dims: Business/Segment cascade (worker -> PC -> product, FULL names, gated on the 8 valid business lines), GLOB (sub-class -> PC, Cyber->FINEX from dims), finance-level remap, Country mapped from the row's finance level (ref_crm_geography + APAC LIKE) with ServiceOfficeCountry / AccountCountry backfill, value mappings (frequency / pipeline-phase / biz-type). Frozen here; inherited by gold facts.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__pipeline_e.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: enriched APAC sales pipeline (all businesses)
-- Faithful port of [APAC Sales Model.ipynb] Batch 3, rebuilt on int_crm__pipeline_base (D365 all-LOBs
-- + Legacy CIS) + the three enriched dims (systemuser / profitcenter / productsubclass). Canonical
-- PascalCase table -- column names frozen here, inherited by fct_crm_pipeline_apac / fct_crm_crb_pipeline.
-- Naming is the SAME vocabulary as pipeline_base (the rename boundary); ID suffixes are upper-case
-- (OpptyID / OriginatingLeadID / GUID). See _crm__column_lineage.md.
--
-- Business precedence (legacy): worker (systemuser dim) -> profit centre -> product (sub-class), all as
-- FULL names. Worker carries full names natively; PC + product are translated short->full inside their
-- dims, so the cascade compares like with like. Rows whose worker/PC business isn't a valid business line
-- fall through to the product business; final null -> UNMAPPED. Output is UPPER (matches NB2's CRB filter).
-- Segment follows the same gate. GLOB (CRB use): product sub-class GLOB, fallback profit-centre GLOB
-- (Cyber -> FINEX already applied in the dims).
--
-- Finance level / Country (NB1 Pass 1-4): Fl1 clean (Vietnam/Korea + office fallback) -> Country mapped
-- from Fl1 via ref_crm_geography (+ APAC LIKE) -> backfill ServiceOfficeCountry + AccountCountry ->
-- FinanceLevelCalc final remap. Name joins normalised TRIM(UPPER()) (Fabric Warehouse BIN2 collation).

with pipeline_base as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_crm__pipeline_base') }}  -- D365 all-LOBs + Legacy CIS history (the FULL base)
),

-- Dims are unique by ID, but the fact joins them by NAME/UPN -- dedup to one row per join key
-- (prefer the row that resolved a Business) so a duplicate name can't fan out the fact.
su as (
    select * from (
        select s.*,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by trim(upper(s.DomainName))
                   order by case when s.Business is not null then 0 else 1 end, s.SystemUserId
               ) as _rn
        from {{ ref('int_crm__systemuser_enriched') }} s
    ) x where _rn = 1
),

pc as (
    select * from (
        select p.*,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by trim(upper(p.ProfitCenterName))
                   order by case when p.Business is not null then 0 else 1 end, p.ProfitCenterId
               ) as _rn
        from {{ ref('int_crm__profitcenter_enriched') }} p
    ) x where _rn = 1
),

sub as (
    select * from (
        select sb.*,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by trim(upper(sb.ProductSubClassName))
                   order by case when sb.Business is not null then 0 else 1 end, sb.ProductSubClassId
               ) as _rn
        from {{ ref('int_crm__productsubclass_enriched') }} sb
    ) x where _rn = 1
),

biz_lines as (
    -- the 8 valid operating LOBs = distinct full names from the code map (single source of truth)
    select distinct trim(upper(BusinessName)) as BusinessName from {{ ref('ref_crm_business_code_map') }}
),

freq as (
    select CrmFrequency, Frequency from (
        select CrmFrequency, Frequency,
               row_number() over (partition by trim(upper(CrmFrequency)) order by Frequency) as rn
        from {{ ref('ref_crm_frequency_map') }}
    ) x where rn = 1
),

phase as (
    select D365PipelinePhase, NewPipelinePhase from (
        select D365PipelinePhase, NewPipelinePhase,
               row_number() over (partition by trim(upper(D365PipelinePhase)) order by NewPipelinePhase) as rn
        from {{ ref('ref_crm_pipeline_phase_map') }}
    ) x where rn = 1
),

biz_type as (
    select CrmType, OpportunityType
    from (
        select CrmType, OpportunityType,
               row_number() over (partition by trim(upper(CrmType)) order by OpportunityType) as rn
        from {{ ref('ref_crm_biz_type_map') }}
    ) x
    where rn = 1
),

-- finance-level -> country geography (mapping data lives in the seed; join is on the row's Fl1, per NB1)
geo as (
    select FinanceLevel, Country from (
        select FinanceLevel, Country,
               row_number() over (partition by trim(upper(FinanceLevel)) order by Country) as rn
        from {{ ref('ref_crm_geography') }}
    ) x where rn = 1
),

apac as (
    select distinct upper(trim(Country)) as Country from {{ ref('ref_crm_apac_countries') }}
),

-- ---- join dims + lookups; first-pass business/segment (b1) + finance level (fl1) ----
base as (
    select
        al.*,
        su.Business as WorkerBusiness,
        su.Segment  as WorkerSegment,
        su.Country  as WorkerCountry,
        su.Lob      as WorkerLob,
        pc.Business as PcBusiness,
        pc.Segment  as PcSegment,
        pc.Glob     as PcGlob,
        -- gate: 'legacy class' products exist only to complete GLOB coverage -- their (blank) business/
        -- segment must NOT feed the cascade, only their GLOB applies
        case when upper(trim(sub.ProductClassName)) = 'LEGACY CLASS' then null else sub.Business end as ProdBusiness,
        case when upper(trim(sub.ProductClassName)) = 'LEGACY CLASS' then null else sub.Segment  end as ProdSegment,
        sub.Glob     as ProdGlob,
        freq.Frequency as FreqMapped,
        phase.NewPipelinePhase as PhaseMapped,
        biz.OpportunityType as BizTypeMapped,
        coalesce(su.Business, pc.Business) as B1,      -- worker -> PC business
        coalesce(su.Segment, pc.Segment)   as B1seg,   -- worker -> PC segment (same precedence)
        case
            when upper(trim(al.FinanceLevel)) = 'VIET NAM'            then 'VIETNAM'
            when upper(trim(al.FinanceLevel)) = 'KOREA (REPUBLIC OF)' then 'SOUTH KOREA'
            when al.FinanceLevel is null or trim(al.FinanceLevel) = '' then al.ServiceOfficeCountry
            else al.FinanceLevel
        end as Fl1
    from pipeline_base al
    left join su  on trim(upper(su.DomainName))           = trim(upper(al.ColleagueInvolvedUpn))
    left join pc  on trim(upper(pc.ProfitCenterName))     = trim(upper(al.ProfitCenter))
    left join sub on trim(upper(sub.ProductSubClassName)) = trim(upper(al.ProductSubClass))
    left join freq  on trim(upper(freq.CrmFrequency))     = trim(upper(al.Frequency))
    left join phase on trim(upper(phase.D365PipelinePhase)) = trim(upper(al.PipelinePhase))
    left join biz_type biz on trim(upper(biz.CrmType))   = trim(upper(al.OpptyType))
),

-- APAC-country LIKE fallback for finance levels not in the geography seed (longest match wins)
fl_keys as (
    select distinct trim(upper(Fl1)) as FlKey from base where Fl1 is not null
),

like_match as (
    select FlKey, Country from (
        select fk.FlKey, ac.Country,
               row_number() over (partition by fk.FlKey order by len(ac.Country) desc) as rn
        from fl_keys fk
        join apac ac on charindex(ac.Country, fk.FlKey) > 0
    ) x where rn = 1
),

-- ---- resolve business / segment / glob / finance level / value mappings ----
derived as (
    select
        b.*,
        -- Business cascade: worker/PC kept if a valid business line, else product; null -> UNMAPPED (UPPER)
        upper(coalesce(
            nullif(case when bl.BusinessName is not null then b.B1 else b.ProdBusiness end, ''),
            'UNMAPPED'
        )) as BusinessCalc,
        -- Segment follows the same gate; null -> NON-OPERATING SEGMENT (UPPER)
        upper(coalesce(
            nullif(case when bl.BusinessName is not null then b.B1seg else b.ProdSegment end, ''),
            'NON-OPERATING SEGMENT'
        )) as SegmentCalc,
        -- GLOB base: product GLOB unless null/unclassified, else profit-centre GLOB (Cyber->FINEX in dims)
        coalesce(
            case when upper(b.ProdGlob) = 'UNCLASSIFIED' then null else b.ProdGlob end,
            b.PcGlob
        ) as GlobBase,
        -- final Finance Level remap (standardised finance level -- NOT a country).
        -- Asia-Specialty finance-level + profit-centre lists inlined from NB1's hardcoded arrays.
        case
            when upper(b.Fl1) in (
                'GLOBAL FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS - GB', 'TPV SINGAPORE TERRORISM', 'P&C - GB',
                'AEROSPACE - GB', 'TPV NA TERRORISM', 'RISK & ANALYTICS - ASIA'
            ) then 'ASIA SPECIALTY'
            when upper(b.ProfitCenter) in (
                'FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS - SINGAPORE', 'SINGAPORE PROPERTY (P&C - GB)', 'TERRORISM - SINGAPORE',
                'CAPTIVES - ASIA', 'LARGE ACCOUNTS - SINGAPORE', 'CRH - CLIMATE AND RESILENCE HUB TEAM',
                'NON GL - ASIA', 'STRATEGIC RISK CONSULTING - ASIA', 'FS SINGAPORE',
                'MARINE CARGO - ASIA SPECIALTY', 'CLIMATE - ASIA', 'GLOBAL FAC - ASIA SPECIALTY'
            ) or upper(b.ProfitCenter) like '%ASIA SPECIALTY%' then 'ASIA SPECIALTY'
            when upper(b.ProfitCenter) = 'JAPAN DESK - SINGAPORE' then 'ASIA DESK REPORTING'
            when upper(b.ProfitCenter) = 'CONSTRUCTION - MALAYSIA' then 'MALAYSIA'
            when upper(b.Fl1) = 'ASIA DESK REPORTING' and upper(b.DataVersion) = 'NON OPPORTUNITY SERVICE'
                then 'ASIA - DESK REPORTING'
            else b.Fl1
        end as FinanceLevelCalc,
        coalesce(nullif(coalesce(b.FreqMapped, b.Frequency), ''), 'UNMAPPED') as FrequencyCalc,
        coalesce(
            b.PhaseMapped,
            case
                when b.PipelinePhase is null and upper(b.OpptyState) like '%OPEN%' then '1 - DISCOVER'
                when b.PipelinePhase is null and upper(b.OpptyState) like '%WON%'  then '5 - FINALISE'
                else b.PipelinePhase
            end
        ) as PipelinePhaseCalc,
        coalesce(nullif(b.Industry, ''), 'UNMAPPED') as IndustryCalc,
        coalesce(nullif(b.GCID, ''), b.Account) as NGcidCalc,
        upper(coalesce(nullif(b.OpptyType, ''), 'UNMAPPED')) as OpptyTypeOrig,
        upper(b.OpptySubType) as OpptySubTypeOrig
    from base b
    left join biz_lines bl on bl.BusinessName = trim(upper(b.B1))
),

-- Country = geography on the row's Fl1 (exact seed match, else APAC LIKE fallback)
geo_resolved as (
    select
        d.*,
        coalesce(ge.Country, lm.Country) as CountryCalc
    from derived d
    left join geo ge       on trim(upper(ge.FinanceLevel)) = trim(upper(d.Fl1))
    left join like_match lm on lm.FlKey = trim(upper(d.Fl1))
),

-- Service Office Country backfill from Country + Korea standardisation (NB1 Pass 2)
country_filled as (
    select
        g.*,
        case
            when g.ServiceOfficeCountry is null or trim(g.ServiceOfficeCountry) = '' then g.CountryCalc
            when upper(g.ServiceOfficeCountry) in ('KOREA, REPUBLIC OF', 'KOREA (REPUBLIC OF)') then 'SOUTH KOREA'
            else g.ServiceOfficeCountry
        end as ServiceOfficeCountryCalc
    from geo_resolved g
),

final as (
    select
        cast(d.DunsNumber                          as varchar(50))   as DunsNumber,
        cast(d.OriginatingLeadID                   as varchar(50))   as OriginatingLeadID,
        cast(d.GUID                                as varchar(50))   as GUID,
        cast(d.OpptyID                             as varchar(50))   as OpptyID,
        cast(d.OpptyName                           as varchar(500))  as OpptyName,
        cast(d.Description                         as varchar(max))  as Description,
        cast(d.FormName                            as varchar(255))  as FormName,
        cast(d.ProductClass                        as varchar(255))  as ProductClass,
        cast(d.ProductSubClass                     as varchar(255))  as ProductSubClass,
        cast(d.Account                             as varchar(500))  as Account,
        cast(d.ParentAccount                       as varchar(500))  as ParentAccount,
        cast(d.GlobalParentAccount                 as varchar(500))  as GlobalParentAccount,
        -- Account Country backfilled from Service Office Country (NB1 Pass 2)
        cast(coalesce(nullif(d.AccountCountry, ''), d.ServiceOfficeCountryCalc)
                                                   as varchar(255))  as AccountCountry,
        cast(d.GCID                                as varchar(150))  as GCID,
        cast(d.NGcidCalc                           as varchar(500))  as NGCID,
        cast(d.Tiers                               as varchar(255))  as Tiers,
        cast(d.IndustryCalc                        as varchar(255))  as Industry,
        cast(d.PrimarySicCode                      as varchar(255))  as PrimarySicCode,
        cast(d.CCY                                 as varchar(10))   as CCY,
        cast(d.EstRevenueLCY                       as decimal(18,2)) as EstRevenueLCY,
        cast(d.EstRevenueUSD                       as decimal(18,2)) as EstRevenueUSD,
        cast(d.WtRevenueLCY                        as decimal(18,2)) as WtRevenueLCY,
        cast(d.WtRevenueUSD                        as decimal(18,2)) as WtRevenueUSD,
        cast(d.PremiumUSD                          as decimal(18,2)) as PremiumUSD,
        cast(d.LikelihoodOfWin                     as varchar(50))   as LikelihoodOfWin,
        -- numeric probability (NB2 strips '%'); coalesce 0. Feeds the DAX n.Status / IsHighVelocity that stay in the model.
        cast(coalesce(try_cast(replace(d.LikelihoodOfWin, '%', '') as decimal(5,2)), 0) as decimal(5,2)) as Probability,
        cast(d.FrequencyCalc                       as varchar(100))  as Frequency,
        cast(d.PipelinePhaseCalc                   as varchar(255))  as PipelinePhase,
        cast(d.OpptyStatus                         as varchar(100))  as OpptyStatus,
        cast(d.OpptyState                          as varchar(100))  as OpptyState,
        -- OpptyType / OpptySubType derivation (NB1 Formula 270)
        -- OpptyType = granular raw (drives AnzOpptyType); OpptySubType = coarse via ref_crm_biz_type_map
        cast(d.OpptyTypeOrig as varchar(100))                       as OpptyType,
        cast(coalesce(d.BizTypeMapped, 'Unmapped') as varchar(100)) as OpptySubType,
        -- AnzOpptyType (NB1) on the derived OpptyType + mapped Frequency
        cast(
            case
                when d.OpptyTypeOrig = 'RENEWAL'
                     and upper(d.FrequencyCalc) in ('RENEWAL','RECURRING & ONE OFF','UNMAPPED') then 'RENEWAL'
                when d.OpptyTypeOrig = 'RENEWAL'
                     and upper(d.FrequencyCalc) = 'ONE OFF' then 'ONE OFF'
                when d.OpptyTypeOrig in ('NEW FROM EXISTING','NEW-NEW','GLOBAL FAC','CROSS SELL','WHOLESALE')
                     and upper(d.FrequencyCalc) in ('RECURRING','RECURRING & ONE OFF') then 'NEW BUSINESS'
                when d.OpptyTypeOrig in ('NEW FROM EXISTING','NEW-NEW','GLOBAL FAC','CROSS SELL','WHOLESALE')
                     and upper(d.FrequencyCalc) in ('ONE OFF','UNMAPPED') then 'ONE OFF'
                else d.OpptyTypeOrig
            end as varchar(100)
        ) as AnzOpptyType,
        -- Owner Business / Segment = legacy worker->PC->product cascade result (UPPER full names).
        -- Owner-prefixed to make the level explicit (these ARE the owner's resolved business/segment, per NB1)
        cast(d.BusinessCalc                        as varchar(255))  as OwnerBusinessName,
        cast(d.SegmentCalc                         as varchar(255))  as OwnerSegmentLobName,
        -- owner attributes straight from the worker dim
        cast(d.WorkerLob                           as varchar(255))  as OwnerLobName,
        cast(coalesce(nullif(d.WorkerCountry, ''), d.ServiceOfficeCountryCalc)
                                                   as varchar(255))  as OwnerCountry,
        -- GLOB: GLOBAL FAC - ASIA SPECIALTY -> FACULTATIVE override, then null/blank -> UNCLASSIFIED
        -- (Cyber -> FINEX already applied in the dims). Mirrors the legacy CRB fact's Power Query rules.
        cast(case
            when upper(trim(d.ProfitCenter)) = 'GLOBAL FAC - ASIA SPECIALTY' then 'FACULTATIVE'
            when d.GlobBase is null or trim(d.GlobBase) = '' then 'UNCLASSIFIED'
            else d.GlobBase
        end as varchar(255)) as Glob,
        -- FinanceLevel = standardised finance level (with ASIA SPECIALTY bucketing) -- the country/finance
        -- dimension for both facts. The geo lookup (CountryCalc) is kept internal only (it backfills
        -- ServiceOfficeCountry / AccountCountry above); it is no longer surfaced as a MappedCountry column.
        cast(d.FinanceLevelCalc                    as varchar(255))  as FinanceLevel,
        cast(d.ServiceOfficeCountryCalc            as varchar(255))  as ServiceOfficeCountry,
        cast(d.ServiceRegion                       as varchar(255))  as ServiceRegion,
        cast(d.ServiceOffice                       as varchar(255))  as ServiceOffice,
        cast(d.ProfitCenter                        as varchar(500))  as ProfitCenter,
        cast(d.OpportunityOwner                    as varchar(500))  as OpportunityOwner,
        cast(d.OpportunityOwnerUpn                 as varchar(500))  as OpportunityOwnerUpn,
        cast(d.Owner                               as varchar(500))  as Owner,
        cast(d.ColleagueInvolvedUpn                as varchar(500))  as ColleagueInvolvedUpn,
        cast(d.TagList                             as varchar(4000)) as TagList,
        cast(d.FirstIncomeDate                     as date)          as FirstIncomeDate,
        -- Inception Date (NB1 'c.Inception Date'): 15th of the First Income month
        cast(case when d.FirstIncomeDate is not null
                  then datefromparts(year(d.FirstIncomeDate), month(d.FirstIncomeDate), 15) end
                                                   as date)          as InceptionDate,
        cast(d.ProjectStartDate                    as date)          as ProjectStartDate,
        cast(d.CloseDate                           as date)          as CloseDate,
        cast(d.CreatedOn                           as datetime2(6))  as CreatedOn,
        cast(d.ModifiedOn                          as date)          as ModifiedOn,
        cast(d.SourceCampaign                      as varchar(255))  as SourceCampaign,
        cast(d.DataVersion                         as varchar(50))   as DataVersion,
        cast(concat(
            'https://wtwcrb.crm.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=af96b65c-0084-ea11-a813-000d3a579b83&forceUCI=1&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=opportunity&id=',
            d.GUID) as varchar(500)
        ) as OppLink
    from country_filled d
)

model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__productsub.description: Product sub-class dimension: parent product-class business/segment (D365 SHORT codes) translated to FULL names via ref_crm_business_code_map (BD&O kept as-is; N/A / Other -> UNMAPPED) + GLOB (by sub-class name, Cyber->FINEX). FULL OUTER JOIN to the GLOB mapping keeps legacy products present in the mapping but no longer in the system table (ProductClassName='legacy class', Business/Segment blank, name + GLOB only) so GLOB coverage stays complete. Joined in the fact on sub-class name.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__productsub.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: enriched Product Sub-Class dimension
-- Business/Segment come from the parent product class (D365 short codes), translated to FULL names via
-- ref_crm_business_code_map so the fact cascade compares like-with-like (worker carries full names).
-- BD&O is kept as-is (no full name); N/A / Other -> UNMAPPED. + GLOB by sub-class name (Cyber -> FINEX).
-- FULL OUTER JOIN to the GLOB mapping: legacy products that exist in the mapping but not in the current
-- system sub-class table are kept (so the GLOB mapping stays complete) -- ProductClassName = 'legacy class',
-- Business/Segment blank, carrying only their name + GLOB.

with sub as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__productsubclass') }}
),

cls as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__productclass') }}
),

-- short -> full lookup (each code maps to exactly one full name + segment)
code_business_map as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('ref_crm_business_code_map') }} where BusinessCode is not null
),

-- GLOB mapping deduped to one row per sub-class name (only row_number we need here)
glob as (
    select ProductSubClassName, Glob
    from (
        select ProductSubClassName, Glob,
               row_number() over (partition by trim(upper(ProductSubClassName)) order by ProductSubClassName) as rn
        from {{ ref('stg_crm__productsubclass_glob_mapping') }}
    ) x where rn = 1
)

select
    cast(sub.ProductSubClassId as varchar(50)) as ProductSubClassId,
    cast(coalesce(sub.ProductSubClassName, g.ProductSubClassName) as varchar(255)) as ProductSubClassName,
    -- system rows keep their class; GLOB-mapping-only legacy products get a 'legacy class' placeholder
    cast(case
        when sub.ProductSubClassId is null then 'legacy class'
        else coalesce(sub.ProductClassName, cls.ProductClassName)
    end as varchar(255)) as ProductClassName,
    -- Business: legacy GLOB-only rows have no system class -> blank; else operating code -> full;
    -- N/A / Other -> UNMAPPED; anything else (BD&O) kept as-is
    cast(case
        when sub.ProductSubClassId is null then ''
        when cbm.BusinessName is not null then cbm.BusinessName
        when upper(trim(cls.BusinessName)) in ('N/A', 'OTHER') then 'UNMAPPED'
        else cls.BusinessName
    end as varchar(255)) as Business,
    -- Segment: blank for legacy GLOB-only rows; else code -> full, keep raw otherwise
    cast(case
        when sub.ProductSubClassId is null then ''
        when cbm.SegmentLobName is not null then cbm.SegmentLobName
        else cls.SegmentName
    end as varchar(255)) as Segment,
    -- GLOB with Cyber -> FINEX applied at the dim
    cast(case when upper(g.Glob) = 'CYBER' then 'FINEX' else g.Glob end as varchar(255)) as Glob
from sub
full outer join glob g     on trim(upper(g.ProductSubClassName)) = trim(upper(sub.ProductSubClassName))
left join cls              on cls.ProductClassId = sub.ProductClassId
left join code_business_map cbm on cbm.BusinessCode = trim(upper(cls.BusinessName))

model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__profitcent.name: int_crm__profitcenter_enriched
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__profitcent.description: Profit-centre dimension. D365 SHORT business/segment codes translated to FULL names via ref_crm_business_code_map (BD&O kept as-is; N/A / Other -> UNMAPPED) + GLOB (by PC name, Cyber->FINEX). FinanceLevel passed through. Country is NOT resolved here -- the fact maps it from the opportunity row's finance level. CRM-only -- billing reads stg_crm__profitcenter, never this dim.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__profitcent.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: enriched Profit Center dimension
-- Business/Segment (D365 short codes) -> full via ref_crm_business_code_map (BD&O kept as-is;
-- N/A / Other -> UNMAPPED). + GLOB by PC name (Cyber -> FINEX). FinanceLevel passed through.
-- Country is NOT resolved here -- the fact maps Country from the opportunity row's finance level
-- (ref_crm_geography), so a PC-level country column would be unused.

with pc as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__profitcenter') }}
),

-- short -> full lookups (plain distinct; each code maps to exactly one full name)
code_business_map as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('ref_crm_business_code_map') }} where BusinessCode is not null
),

-- GLOB mapping deduped to one row per PC name (only row_number we need here)
glob as (
    select ProfitCenterName, Glob
    from (
        select ProfitCenterName, Glob,
               row_number() over (partition by trim(upper(ProfitCenterName)) order by ProfitCenterName) as rn
        from {{ ref('stg_crm__profitcenter_glob_mapping') }}
    ) x where rn = 1
)

select
    cast(pc.ProfitCenterId   as varchar(50))  as ProfitCenterId,
    cast(pc.ProfitCenterName as varchar(500)) as ProfitCenterName,
    -- Business: operating code -> full; N/A / Other -> UNMAPPED; anything else (BD&O) kept as-is
    cast(case
        when cbm.BusinessName is not null then cbm.BusinessName
        when upper(trim(pc.BusinessName)) in ('N/A', 'OTHER') then 'UNMAPPED'
        else pc.BusinessName
    end as varchar(255)) as Business,
    -- Segment: code -> full, else keep raw
    cast(case
        when cbm.SegmentLobName is not null then cbm.SegmentLobName
        else pc.SegmentName
    end as varchar(255)) as Segment,    
    cast(pc.LobName          as varchar(255)) as Lob,
    cast(pc.FinanceLevelName as varchar(255)) as FinanceLevel,
    -- GLOB with Cyber -> FINEX applied at the dim
    cast(case when upper(g.Glob) = 'CYBER' then 'FINEX' else g.Glob end as varchar(255)) as Glob
from pc
left join code_business_map cbm on cbm.BusinessCode = trim(upper(pc.BusinessName))
left join glob g           on trim(upper(g.ProfitCenterName)) = trim(upper(pc.ProfitCenterName))

model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__systemuser.name: int_crm__systemuser_enriched
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__systemuser.description: System user enriched with rs_workers (active, UPN-deduped) -> owner Business/Segment/Country/Lob, FULL names passed through unchanged (PC + product dims translate short->full to match). Worker is the 1st-precedence Business source. Joined in the fact on DomainName = Colleague Involved UPN.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_crm__systemuser.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: enriched System User dimension
-- stg_crm__systemuser + stg_crm__worker (active, UPN-deduped) joined on UPN. The worker carries
-- FULL business/segment names (e.g. 'Corporate Risk & Broking') -- passed through unchanged; no code
-- mapping (PC + product dims translate their short names UP to full, so all three sources agree).
-- Emits the worker's owner attributes (Business / Segment / Country / Lob) keyed on DomainName (UPN).
-- Consumed by int_crm__pipeline_enriched as the 1st (highest-precedence) Business source (legacy NB1).

with su as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_crm__systemuser') }}
),

-- legacy NB: statuscodename = 'ACTIVE' + non-null business, then dedup on UPN
worker as (
    select Upn, BusinessName, SegmentLobName, LobName, Country
    from (
        select
            Upn,
            BusinessName,
            SegmentLobName,
            LobName,
            Country,
            row_number() over (partition by trim(upper(Upn)) order by WorkerId) as rn
        from {{ ref('stg_crm__worker') }}
        where upper(StatusCodeName) = 'ACTIVE'
          and BusinessName is not null
    ) x
    where rn = 1
)

select
    cast(su.SystemUserId     as varchar(50))  as SystemUserId,
    cast(su.FullName         as varchar(500)) as FullName,
    cast(su.DomainName       as varchar(255)) as DomainName,
    cast(su.TerritoryName    as varchar(255)) as TerritoryName,
    cast(su.OfficeName       as varchar(255)) as OfficeName,
    cast(su.ProfitCenterName as varchar(500)) as ProfitCenterName,
    -- worker owner attributes (full names, pass-through)
    cast(w.BusinessName      as varchar(255)) as Business,
    cast(w.SegmentLobName    as varchar(255)) as Segment,
    cast(w.Country           as varchar(255)) as Country,
    cast(w.LobName           as varchar(255)) as Lob
from su
left join worker w
    on trim(upper(w.Upn)) = trim(upper(su.DomainName))

model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_acc.name: int_finance__mr_accumulated
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_acc.description: THE YEAR GATE. Incremental delete+insert on YearKey; full_refresh disabled so accumulated years cannot be wiped. Bootstrap-seeded from the legacy historical tables on first build. Marts read this model ONLY. Aged years are written back to the bronze CRB_MR_Historical* tables by 99_archive_finance_mr_historical.ipynb.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_acc.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Finance MR accumulated -- THE YEAR GATE
-- Source:  {{ ref('int_finance__mr_enriched') }} (live file = current year only)
--          + stg_finance__mr_historical_plan / _actual (BOOTSTRAP branch only)
-- Output:  apac_finance_silver.int_finance__mr_accumulated (incremental table)
--
-- The source CRB Revenue.xlsx only ever contains the CURRENT year. This model is the
-- single store holding ALL years:
--   - Every run: delete+insert keyed on YearKey replaces the year(s) present in the
--     incoming batch and never touches other years. At rollover, the new year inserts
--     alongside the preserved old years.
--   - First build / recovery: the bootstrap branch seeds pre-existing history from the
--     legacy CRB_MR_Historical* tables (kept current by 99_archive_finance_mr_historical).
--   - full_refresh=false: `dbt build --full-refresh` will NOT rebuild this model --
--     accumulated years cannot be wiped. Schema changes therefore need a manual ALTER
--     (or a deliberate one-off: drop table, then a normal run re-seeds via bootstrap).
--
-- January runbook: keep mr_source_year pinned to the OLD year until finance confirms
-- the file has rolled; a mislabeled year self-heals on rerun (delete+insert by year).
-- Marts read THIS model only -- historical staging views feed the bootstrap alone,
-- so archive write-back cannot double count.

{{ config(
    materialized = 'incremental',
    incremental_strategy = 'delete+insert',
    unique_key = 'YearKey',
    full_refresh = false
) }}

with live as (
    select
        cast(year(PlanPeriod) as int)          as YearKey,
        cast(Scenario as varchar(10))          as Scenario,
        cast(Country as varchar(255))          as Country,
        cast(MrGlob as varchar(255))           as MrGlob,
        cast(IncomeType as varchar(255))       as IncomeType,
        cast(RevenueType as varchar(50))       as RevenueType,
        cast(PlanPeriod as datetime2(6))       as PlanPeriod,
        cast(GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GlobForDashboard,
        cast(Amount as decimal(18,2))          as Amount
    from {{ ref('int_finance__mr_enriched') }}
)

select * from live

{% if not is_incremental() %}
-- Bootstrap (first build / recovery only): seed pre-existing history from the legacy
-- archive tables. Year-guarded so a historical table containing the live year can
-- never overlap the live batch.
-- GlobForDashboard canonicalized against the GLOB seed here: the legacy tables carry
-- UPPERCASED labels ('CARGO') while the live branch uses seed casing ('Cargo') -- a
-- case-insensitive seed match takes the seed's form, anything unknown collapses to
-- UPPER so no label can exist in two forms. Fixing it at ingest keeps the store and
-- every downstream mart clean with zero per-run cost.
-- NOTE: changing this branch only affects the NEXT bootstrap. To clean an already-built
-- store: drop apac_finance_silver.int_finance__mr_accumulated once, then a normal run
-- re-seeds through this branch.
union all
select
    cast(year(h.PlanPeriod) as int)            as YearKey,
    cast(h.Scenario as varchar(10))            as Scenario,
    cast(h.Country as varchar(255))            as Country,
    cast(h.MrGlob as varchar(255))             as MrGlob,
    cast(h.IncomeType as varchar(255))         as IncomeType,
    cast(h.RevenueType as varchar(50))         as RevenueType,
    cast(h.PlanPeriod as datetime2(6))         as PlanPeriod,
    cast(coalesce(c.GlobForDashboard, upper(h.GlobForDashboard)) as varchar(255)) as GlobForDashboard,
    cast(h.Amount as decimal(18,2))            as Amount
from (
    select Scenario, Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard, Amount
    from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_historical_plan') }}
    union all
    select Scenario, Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard, Amount
    from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_historical_actual') }}
) h
left join (
    select GlobForDashboard, upper(ltrim(rtrim(GlobForDashboard))) as KeyU
    from (select distinct GlobForDashboard from {{ ref('ref_finance_mr_glob_mapping') }}) s
) c
  on upper(ltrim(rtrim(h.GlobForDashboard))) = c.KeyU
where cast(year(h.PlanPeriod) as int) not in (select distinct YearKey from live)
{% endif %}

model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_bas.name: int_finance__mr_base
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_bas.description: Slices the three MR month blocks and unpivots them long (Scenario x MonthNum), replacing the legacy CRB_MR_Plan/Actual/Forecast M queries. Year comes from the mr_source_year var (default: year(getdate())) -- the file itself carries no year.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_bas.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Finance MR base (Plan + Actual + Forecast unpivoted, long format)
-- Source:  {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_revenue') }}
-- Output:  apac_finance_silver.int_finance__mr_base (table)
-- Replaces the three legacy M queries CRB_MR_Plan / CRB_MR_Actual / CRB_MR_Forecast
-- (Fabric-Bronze/Finance/CRB_MR_*.m): slices the three month blocks, unpivots 12 months
-- per scenario via UNION ALL (multi-row VALUES constructor is unsupported on Fabric WH),
-- applies the scenario-aware country filters and the RevenueType collapse.
--
-- Year priority (legacy M hardcoded '2026-'):
--   1. mr_source_year var, when explicitly set (backfill / manual override)
--   2. the file's own FY label -- the metadata rows carry 'FY26' at RowIndex 6, repeated
--      across the value columns (verified in the raw sheet). This is the normal path and
--      removes the January-mislabel risk: the file says FY26 until finance rolls it.
--   3. year(getdate()) as last resort (also caught by the drift test's FY-cell check).
--
-- Null month cells are dropped to match M's UnpivotOtherColumns (which discards nulls).

with base as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_revenue') }}
    where RowIndex >= 9   -- rows 0-7 = junk (M Table.Skip(8)), row 8 = header row
),

file_year as (
    -- 'FY26' -> '2026'. Read from the first month column of each block (label row spans
    -- all value columns); max() collapses to a scalar, like-guard rejects garbage.
    select max('20' + substring(FyLabel, 3, 2)) as FileYear
    from (
        select ltrim(rtrim(coalesce(Actual01, Forecast01, Plan01))) as FyLabel
        from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_revenue') }}
        where RowIndex = 6
    ) fy
    where FyLabel like 'FY[0-9][0-9]'
),

source_year as (
    select cast(
        coalesce(
            nullif('{{ var("mr_source_year", "") }}', ''),
            (select FileYear from file_year),
            cast(year(getdate()) as varchar(4))
        ) as int
    ) as SourceYear
),

unpivoted as (
{%- set scenarios = ['Plan', 'Actual', 'Forecast'] %}
{%- for s in scenarios %}
{%- set outer = loop %}
{%- for m in range(1, 13) %}
    select
        cast('{{ s }}' as varchar(10))       as Scenario,
        Country,
        Glob,
        IncomeType,
        RevenueTypeRaw,
        {{ m }}                              as MonthNum,
        {{ s }}{{ '%02d' % m }}              as RawValue
    from base
    where {{ s }}{{ '%02d' % m }} is not null
      and ltrim(rtrim({{ s }}{{ '%02d' % m }})) <> ''
    {%- if not (outer.last and loop.last) %}
    union all
    {%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}
{%- endfor %}
),

-- Country + Revenue Type filters transcribed verbatim from the legacy M queries.
-- Fabric WH default collation is case-sensitive (BIN2), matching M's List.Contains semantics.
filtered as (
    select u.*, y.SourceYear
    from unpivoted u
    cross join source_year y
    where u.Country is not null
      and u.RevenueTypeRaw is not null
      and u.RevenueTypeRaw <> '_Total C&F'
      and u.RevenueTypeRaw <> '_Total Revenue'
      and (
            (u.Scenario = 'Plan' and u.Country in (
                'Asia Virtual City - Asia Headquarters 2 virtual',
                'Cambodia', 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Indonesia',
                'Japan', 'Malaysia', 'Philippines', 'Seoul',
                'Singapore', 'South Korea City', 'Taiwan',
                'Vietnam', 'Asia Virtual City - Asia Regional Resources Virtual Office',
                'India'
            ))
         or (u.Scenario in ('Actual', 'Forecast') and u.Country not in (
                'Asia Sub-Region',
                'Asia Virtual City - Asia Headquarters',
                'Asia Virtual City - Asia Headquarters 2',
                'Asia Virtual City - Asia Regional Resources',
                'Asia Virtual City - Hong Kong Regional',
                'Asia Virtual City - Singapore Regional'
            ))
      )
),

final as (
    select
        cast(Scenario as varchar(10))                       as Scenario,
        cast(Country as varchar(255))                       as Country,
        cast(Glob as varchar(255))                          as Glob,
        cast(IncomeType as varchar(255))                    as IncomeType,
        -- M Text.Contains is case-sensitive; charindex on BIN2 collation matches.
        cast(
            case
                when charindex('Renewals', RevenueTypeRaw) > 0 then 'Renewal'
                when charindex('New',      RevenueTypeRaw) > 0 then 'New Business'
                when charindex('MDI',      RevenueTypeRaw) > 0 then 'MDI'
                when charindex('One',      RevenueTypeRaw) > 0 then 'One-Off'
                else 'Others'
            end
            as varchar(50)
        )                                                   as RevenueType,
        cast(datefromparts(SourceYear, MonthNum, 1) as datetime2(6)) as PlanPeriod,
        COALESCE(try_cast(RawValue as decimal(18,2)),0)                 as Amount
    from filtered
)

select * from final

model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_enr.name: int_finance__mr_enriched
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_enr.description: Silver business logic (regional P&C split, Marine All Other netting, GLOB mapping, country remap, Plan-only MDI exclusions), replacing 02_silver_pipeline_crm_crb_mr. Marine All Other = Marine LOB minus Cargo, matched on Country+IncomeType+PlanPeriod -- verified 2026-07-06 against the legacy Alteryx workflow (APAC CRB Data Refresh.yxmd) and PySpark notebook, both of which perform the identical subtraction. A negative result for a given country/period (e.g. Singapore Plan FY26) reflects the source data as-is, not a transform defect.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_enr.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Finance MR enriched (silver business logic)
-- Source:  {{ ref('int_finance__mr_base') }} + {{ ref('ref_finance_mr_glob_mapping') }} (seed)
-- Output:  apac_finance_silver.int_finance__mr_enriched (table)
-- Replaces the legacy PySpark silver notebook 02_silver_pipeline_crm_crb_mr
-- (Fabric-Silver/Finance/02_silver_pipeline_crm_crb_mr.ipynb), scenario-generic:
--   1. Regional split: Global Markets P&C Hub + Asia HQ 2 Virtual -> 'Asia Specialty',
--      GlobForDashboard hardcoded 'P&C', bypasses mapping join and MDI filters.
--   2. Marine All Other = Marine LOB minus Cargo, matched on Country+IncomeType+PlanPeriod.
--      NOTE: the legacy match key ignores RevenueType and cargo can match on Glob-contains-
--      'CARGO' more than once per key -> potential fan-out. Replicated verbatim for parity.
--   3. Main set excludes 7 GLOBs + the P&C/Asia-HQ-2 combo, unions Marine All Other.
--   4. GLOB mapping left join (TRIM+UPPER both sides -- deliberate hardening vs the legacy
--      notebook's exact-match join), Glob renamed MrGlob.
--   5. Country remap (Seoul / Korea / South Korea City -> South Korea, etc.).
--   6. MDI exclusion filters, Plan scenario only.
--   7. Union with regional rows.

with unpivoted as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_finance__mr_base') }}
),

glob_mapping as (
    select
        cast(GlobForMr as varchar(255))        as GlobForMr,
        cast(GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GlobForDashboard
    from {{ ref('ref_finance_mr_glob_mapping') }}
),

-- 1. Regional Global Markets P&C (computed from the UNFILTERED set, as in the notebook)
regional as (
    select
        cast(Scenario as varchar(10))        as Scenario,
        cast(
            case
                when Country = 'Asia Virtual City - Asia Headquarters 2 virtual'
                    then 'Asia Specialty'
                when Country = 'Asia Virtual City - Asia Regional Resources Virtual Office'
                    then 'Asia Virtual Finance Plug'
                else Country
            end
            as varchar(255)
        )                                    as Country,
        cast(Glob as varchar(255))           as MrGlob,
        cast(IncomeType as varchar(255))     as IncomeType,
        cast(RevenueType as varchar(50))     as RevenueType,
        PlanPeriod,
        cast('P&C' as varchar(255))          as GlobForDashboard,
        Amount
    from unpivoted
    where upper(Glob) = 'GLOBAL MARKETS P&C HUB'
      and upper(Country) = 'ASIA VIRTUAL CITY - ASIA HEADQUARTERS 2 VIRTUAL'
),

-- 2. Marine All Other: Marine LOB value minus Cargo value on the legacy match key
marine as (
    select * from unpivoted where upper(Glob) = 'MARINE LOB'
),

cargo as (
    select * from unpivoted where charindex('CARGO', upper(Glob)) > 0
),

marine_all_other as (
    select
        m.Scenario,
        m.Country,
        cast('Marine All Other' as varchar(255))       as Glob,
        m.IncomeType,
        m.RevenueType,
        m.PlanPeriod,
        cast(m.Amount - c.Amount as decimal(18,2))     as Amount
    from marine m
    inner join cargo c
      on  m.Scenario = c.Scenario
      and upper(ltrim(rtrim(m.Country)))    = upper(ltrim(rtrim(c.Country)))
      and upper(ltrim(rtrim(m.IncomeType))) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(c.IncomeType)))
      and m.PlanPeriod = c.PlanPeriod
),

-- 3. Main set: exclude the regional/marine GLOBs, union Marine All Other back in
main_filtered as (
    select Scenario, Country, Glob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, Amount
    from unpivoted
    where upper(Glob) not in (
            'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING',
            'CRB RISK',
            'FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS LOB',
            'FINEX M&A ADVISORY',
            'FINMAR PRACTICE',
            'GLOBAL MARKETS P&C HUB',
            'MARINE LOB'
          )
      and not (
            upper(Glob) = 'PROPERTY & CASUALTY BUSINESS'
        and upper(Country) = 'ASIA VIRTUAL CITY - ASIA HEADQUARTERS 2 VIRTUAL'
          )

    union all

    select Scenario, Country, Glob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, Amount
    from marine_all_other
),

-- 4. GLOB mapping join + 5. country remap
mapped as (
    select
        cast(mm.Scenario as varchar(10))     as Scenario,
        cast(
            case
                when mm.Country = 'Asia Virtual City - Asia Headquarters 2 virtual'
                    then 'Asia Specialty'
                when mm.Country = 'Asia Virtual City - Asia Regional Resources Virtual Office'
                    then 'Asia Virtual Finance Plug'
                when mm.Country = 'South Korea City' then 'South Korea'
                when mm.Country = 'Seoul'            then 'South Korea'
                when mm.Country = 'Korea'            then 'South Korea'
                else mm.Country
            end
            as varchar(255)
        )                                    as Country,
        cast(mm.Glob as varchar(255))        as MrGlob,
        cast(mm.IncomeType as varchar(255))  as IncomeType,
        cast(mm.RevenueType as varchar(50))  as RevenueType,
        mm.PlanPeriod,
        cast(map.GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GlobForDashboard,
        mm.Amount
    from main_filtered mm
    left join glob_mapping map
      on upper(ltrim(rtrim(mm.Glob))) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(map.GlobForMr)))
),

-- 6. MDI exclusions (Plan only, post-remap Country values as in the notebook)
mdi_filtered as (
    select * from mapped
    where not (
            Scenario = 'Plan'
        and Country = 'China'
        and MrGlob = 'Carriers, Facilities & Panels Revenue Team'
        and RevenueType = 'MDI'
          )
      and not (
            Scenario = 'Plan'
        and Country = 'Asia Specialty'
        and MrGlob = 'Property & Casualty LOB'
        and RevenueType = 'MDI'
          )
),

-- 7. Union with regional rows
final as (
    select Scenario, Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard, Amount
    from mdi_filtered

    union all

    select Scenario, Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard, Amount
    from regional
)

select
    cast(Scenario as varchar(10))          as Scenario,
    cast(Country as varchar(255))          as Country,
    cast(MrGlob as varchar(255))           as MrGlob,
    cast(IncomeType as varchar(255))       as IncomeType,
    cast(RevenueType as varchar(50))       as RevenueType,
    PlanPeriod,
    cast(GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GlobForDashboard,
    Amount
from final

model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_rea.description: Year gate for the reallocation deltas -- same delete+insert-on-YearKey mechanics as int_finance__mr_accumulated, but with NO bootstrap (no historical reallocation data; pre-2026 years have no deltas). full_refresh disabled. Zero-sum per year, guarded by tests/assert_finance_mr_realloc_zero_sum.sql.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_rea.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Finance MR reallocation deltas accumulated -- year gate
-- Source:  {{ ref('int_finance__mr_realloc_delta') }} (reallocate file = current year only)
-- Output:  apac_finance_silver.int_finance__mr_realloc_accumulated (incremental table)
--
-- Same year-gate mechanics as int_finance__mr_accumulated: the reallocation source only ever
-- carries the current year, so delete+insert on YearKey replaces that year's deltas and never
-- touches frozen years. NO bootstrap branch -- there is no historical reallocation data;
-- pre-2026 years simply have no delta rows (reallocated == standard for them).
-- full_refresh=false protects frozen delta years; schema changes need manual ALTER
-- (or deliberate drop + normal run, accepting loss of aged delta years -- unlike the main
-- accumulated table there is no archive write-back for deltas).

{{ config(
    materialized = 'incremental',
    incremental_strategy = 'delete+insert',
    unique_key = 'YearKey',
    full_refresh = false
) }}

select
    cast(year(PlanPeriod) as int)          as YearKey,
    cast(Country as varchar(255))          as Country,
    cast(MrGlob as varchar(255))           as MrGlob,
    cast(IncomeType as varchar(255))       as IncomeType,
    cast(RevenueType as varchar(50))       as RevenueType,
    cast(PlanPeriod as datetime2(6))       as PlanPeriod,
    cast(GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GlobForDashboard,
    cast(Amount as decimal(18,2))          as Amount
from {{ ref('int_finance__mr_realloc_delta') }}

model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_rea.name: int_finance__mr_realloc_delta
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_rea.description: Zero-sum plan-target reallocation deltas: + at the true market (Adjusted Insured Country, Seoul -> South Korea), - at Asia Specialty. LOB -> MRGLOB with the Marine/Cargo carve-out (Marine LOB + Team contains 'Cargo' -> Cargo Practice; other Marine LOB -> Marine All Other; Large and Complex P&C -> Global Markets P&C Hub). ProductType -> RevenueType and ProductType x Classification -> IncomeType (the fact's deterministic bucket pairs). GlobForDashboard via the GLOB seed. Grouped to fact grain.
model.apac_sales_etl.int_finance__mr_rea.raw_code:
-- Intermediate: Finance MR plan-target reallocation deltas
-- Source:  {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_reallocate') }} + {{ ref('ref_finance_mr_glob_mapping') }} (seed)
-- Output:  apac_finance_silver.int_finance__mr_realloc_delta (table)
-- Zero-sum movement of plan target out of Asia Specialty into the true markets:
--   + sum(WeightedRevenueUsd) at the adjusted country
--   - sum(WeightedRevenueUsd) at Asia Specialty (same other dims)
-- Rows with AdjustedInsuredCountry = 'Asia Virtual Country' stay in Asia Specialty (excluded).
--
-- Mappings (confirmed with Prisco 2026-07-06):
--   LOB -> MRGLOB with the Marine/Cargo carve-out mirroring int_finance__mr_enriched
--     (there: Cargo is netted OUT of Marine LOB, cargo lives under 'Cargo Practice'):
--     'Marine LOB' + Team contains 'Cargo' -> 'Cargo Practice';
--     'Marine LOB' (Hull / P&I / rest)     -> 'Marine All Other';
--     'Large and Complex P&C'              -> 'Global Markets P&C Hub';
--     others pass through. GlobForDashboard via the GLOB seed.
--   ProductType -> RevenueType and (ProductType x Classification) -> IncomeType
--     (corrected 2026-07-06 -- Classification alone had collapsed everything into
--     Renewal/MDI and the NB Target never moved under reallocation):
--       MDI                        -> Market Derived Income / MDI
--       New New      x Brokerage   -> New Business Brokerage Revenue - New Business / New Business
--       New Existing x Brokerage   -> New Business Brokerage Revenue - Existing     / New Business
--       New New      x Fees        -> New Business Fee Revenue - New Business       / New Business
--       New Existing x Fees        -> New Business Fee Revenue - Existing           / New Business
--       One-Off      x Brokerage   -> One Off Brokerage Revenue                     / One-Off
--       One-Off      x Fees        -> One Off Fee Revenue                           / One-Off
--       Renewal      x Brokerage   -> Brokerage                                     / Renewal
--       Renewal      x Fees        -> Fees                                          / Renewal
--     These are the exact deterministic bucket pairs the fact already carries, so
--     deltas net inside real plan numbers at matching grain.
--   Country label: 'Seoul' -> 'South Korea' (fact vocabulary).

with stg as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_reallocate') }}
    where ScenarioType = 'Plan'
      and AdjustedInsuredCountry <> 'Asia Virtual Country'
),

glob_mapping as (
    select
        cast(GlobForMr as varchar(255))        as GlobForMr,
        cast(GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GlobForDashboard
    from {{ ref('ref_finance_mr_glob_mapping') }}
),

mapped as (
    select
        cast(
            case AdjustedInsuredCountry
                when 'Seoul' then 'South Korea'
                else AdjustedInsuredCountry
            end
            as varchar(255)
        )                                            as TargetCountry,
        cast(
            case
                when Lob = 'Marine LOB' and charindex('CARGO', upper(Team)) > 0
                    then 'Cargo Practice'
                when Lob = 'Marine LOB'
                    then 'Marine All Other'
                when Lob = 'Large and Complex P&C'
                    then 'Global Markets P&C Hub'
                else Lob
            end
            as varchar(255)
        )                                            as MrGlob,
        cast(
            case
                when Classification = 'MDI'
                    then 'Market Derived Income'
                when ProductType = 'New New'      and Classification = 'Brokerage'
                    then 'New Business Brokerage Revenue - New Business'
                when ProductType = 'New Existing' and Classification = 'Brokerage'
                    then 'New Business Brokerage Revenue - Existing'
                when ProductType = 'New New'      and Classification = 'Fees'
                    then 'New Business Fee Revenue - New Business'
                when ProductType = 'New Existing' and Classification = 'Fees'
                    then 'New Business Fee Revenue - Existing'
                when ProductType = 'One-Off'      and Classification = 'Brokerage'
                    then 'One Off Brokerage Revenue'
                when ProductType = 'One-Off'      and Classification = 'Fees'
                    then 'One Off Fee Revenue'
                when ProductType = 'Renewal'      and Classification = 'Brokerage'
                    then 'Brokerage'
                when ProductType = 'Renewal'      and Classification = 'Fees'
                    then 'Fees'
            end
            as varchar(255)
        )                                            as IncomeType,
        cast(
            case

-- Mart: fct_billing_baseline
-- Output: apac_billing_gold.fct_billing_baseline (table)
-- Unified baseline fact -- UNION ALL of 8 billing sources + CIS historical + CRM, conformed to 22-column schema.
-- CRM source = int_crm__crm_baseline (H&B All-LOBs + rest-of-HWC income assignment).
--
-- Output = 20 columns: the 18-col baseline schema + [Product/Service] + [SubProduct/Service].
--   * Product/Service / SubProduct/Service -- WR SPM + CIS populate; others via product mapping.
--   * SystemProductClass2 -- carried internally for the Eclipse override only (NOT output).
--   * OpptyState -- carried internally from the CRM source; NOT output (matches legacy).
--
-- Mirrors the legacy baseline_final_TX gold view. Pipeline: unioned -> fx -> fx_converted -> final transforms:
--   1. FX: convert non-USD Revenue/Premium to USD. stg_billing__exchange_rate is unpivoted inline
--      (date columns discovered dynamically), join on Currency + income year = latest rate that year;
--      falls back to the currency's latest year.
--   2. Product mapping: stg_billing__product_mapping for all sources; CIS RDI/WRC -> full label; SPM passthrough.
--   3. Final transforms: Eclipse SystemProductClass2 override; RevenueCountry normalization
--      (KOREA->SOUTH KOREA, INDIA CONSULTING->INDIA, Viet Nam->Vietnam); GCID dash-strip.

-- Discover the exchange-rate date columns dynamically from the Bronze source (always present at
-- compile time, avoiding a stg-view compile-order race). New rate columns flow in with no code change.
{% set fx_source = source('bronze_billing', 'src_billing_exchange_rate') %}
{% set fx_all_cols = adapter.get_columns_in_relation(fx_source) %}
{% set fx_date_cols = [] %}
{% for col in fx_all_cols %}
    {% if col.name | upper != 'CURRENCY' %}{% do fx_date_cols.append(col.name) %}{% endif %}
{% endfor %}

-- The ref() to the exchange rate view is inside the fx_unpivoted for-loop, which dbt's static
-- parser cannot see. Declare the dependency explicitly so dbt builds it first:
-- depends_on: {{ ref('stg_billing__exchange_rate') }}

with arias as (
    select
        SystemClientName,
        SystemProductClass,
        TX_ID,
        IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue,
        Premium,
        SystemID,
        RevenueCountry,
        ClientID,
        DataSource,
        Segment,
        BusinessType,
        RecurringRevenue,
        RevenueCities,
        DUNSNO,
        Currency,
        GCID,
        [Source],
        cast(null as varchar(255)) as [SubProduct/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255)) as [Product/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255)) as SystemProductClass2,
        cast(null as varchar(50))  as OpptyState
    from {{ ref('int_billing__arias_enriched') }}
),

saiba as (
    select
        SystemClientName, SystemProductClass, TX_ID, IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue, Premium, SystemID, RevenueCountry, ClientID,
        DataSource, Segment, BusinessType, RecurringRevenue, RevenueCities,
        DUNSNO, Currency, GCID, [Source],
        cast(null as varchar(255)) as [SubProduct/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255)) as [Product/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255)) as SystemProductClass2,
        cast(null as varchar(50))  as OpptyState
    from {{ ref('int_billing__saiba_enriched') }}
),

eclipse_crb as (

    from {{ ref('int_billing__eclipse_crb_enriched') }}

eglobal_income as (

        Revenue, Premium, SystemID, RevenueCountry, ClientID,
        DataSource, Segment, BusinessType, RecurringRevenue, RevenueCities,
        DUNSNO, Currency, GCID, [Source],

        cast(null as varchar(255)) as [Product/Service],
        cast(null as varchar(255)) as SystemProductClass2,
        cast(null as varchar(50))  as OpptyState
    from {{ ref('int_billing__eglobal_income_enriched') }}
),

gswin as (
    select
        SystemClientName, SystemProductClass, TX_ID, IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue, Premium, SystemID, RevenueCountry, ClientID,

),

    from {{ ref('int_billing__wr_spm_enriched') }}
),

        SystemClientName, SystemProductClass, TX_ID, IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue, Premium, SystemID, RevenueCountry, ClientID,
        DataSource, Segment, BusinessType, RecurringRevenue, RevenueCities,

        cast(null as varchar(50))  as OpptyState
    from {{ ref('int_billing__cis_historical_enriched') }}

    select
        SystemClientName, SystemProductClass, TX_ID, IncomeInceptionDate,
        Revenue, Premium, SystemID, RevenueCountry, ClientID,

    from {{ ref('int_crm__crm_baseline') }}

unioned as (
    select * from arias
    union all select * from saiba
    union all select * from eclipse_crb
    union all select * from eglobal_income
    union all select * from gswin
    union all select * from ret_oracle
    union all select * from wr_spm
    union all select * from cis_historical
    union all select * from crm
),

-- FX unpivot: wide rate table (one row per currency, one column per month-end 'YYYY-MM-DD') -> long.
-- Columns discovered dynamically above. Non-date / non-numeric columns drop out via try_cast.
-- Rate cast via FLOAT: the varchar source stores tiny rates in scientific notation ('6.198e-05'
-- for IDR/VND), which try_cast to decimal returns NULL for -- that silently NULLed all Indonesia
-- revenue. float parses scientific notation.
fx_unpivoted as (
    {% if fx_date_cols %}
    {% for col in fx_date_cols %}
        select
            CURRENCY                                  as Currency,
            '{{ col }}'                               as RateLabel,
            try_cast([{{ col }}] as float)            as Rate
        from {{ ref('stg_billing__exchange_rate') }}
        {% if not loop.last %}union all{% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
    {% else %}
        select cast(null as varchar(10)) as Currency, cast(null as varchar(20)) as RateLabel, cast(null as float) as Rate
        where 1 = 0
    {% endif %}
),

fx_parsed as (
    select
        Currency,
        -- labels are 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> year is the first 4 chars, month is chars 6-7
        try_cast(left(RateLabel, 4) as int)         as RateYear,
        try_cast(substring(RateLabel, 6, 2) as int) as RateMonth,
        Rate
    from fx_unpivoted
    where Rate is not null
),

-- latest available month-end rate within each (currency, year)
fx_year as (
    select Currency, RateYear, Rate
    from (
        select Currency, RateYear, Rate,
               row_number() over (partition by Currency, RateYear order by RateMonth desc) as rn
        from fx_parsed
        where RateYear is not null
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),

-- fallback: the currency's latest year, for income years with no rate at all
fx_latest as (
    select Currency, Rate
    from (
        select Currency, Rate,
               row_number() over (partition by Currency order by RateYear desc) as rn
        from fx_year
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),

-- FX convert: non-USD Revenue/Premium -> USD. Join on Currency + income year (latest rate that
-- year); fall back to the currency's latest year. Revenue and Premium use the same rate.
-- USD / null currency pass through unchanged.
fx_converted as (
    select
        u.SystemClientName,
        u.SystemProductClass,
        u.TX_ID,
        u.IncomeInceptionDate,
        cast(
            case
                when u.Currency = 'USD' or u.Currency is null then u.Revenue
                else u.Revenue * coalesce(fx.Rate, fxl.Rate)
            end
            as decimal(18,2)
        )                          as Revenue,
        cast(
            case
                when u.Currency = 'USD' or u.Currency is null then u.Premium
                else u.Premium * coalesce(fx.Rate, fxl.Rate)
            end
            as decimal(18,2)
        )                          as Premium,
        u.SystemID,
        u.RevenueCountry,
        u.ClientID,
        u.DataSource,
        u.Segment,
        u.BusinessType,
        u.RecurringRevenue,
        u.RevenueCities,
        u.DUNSNO,
        u.Currency,
        u.GCID,
        u.[Source],
        u.[Product/Service],
        u.[SubProduct/Service],
        u.SystemProductClass2,
        u.OpptyState
    from unioned u
    left join fx_year fx
        on u.Currency = fx.Currency
       and year(u.IncomeInceptionDate) = fx.RateYear
    left join fx_latest fxl
        on u.Currency = fxl.Currency
)

-- Final transforms (legacy baseline_final_TX step 4):
--   * SystemProductClass: Eclipse -> SystemProductClass2 when present
--   * RevenueCountry: KOREA->SOUTH KOREA, INDIA CONSULTING->INDIA, Viet Nam->Vietnam
--   * GCID: strip dashes
--   * Product/Service & SubProduct/Service: CIS special (keyed on [Source]='CIS'), SPM passthrough
--     (already cleaned at int), all other sources mapped from stg_billing__product_mapping.
select
    c.SystemClientName,
    cast(
        case
            when c.DataSource = 'ECLIPSE' and c.SystemProductClass2 is not null then c.SystemProductClass2
            else c.SystemProductClass
        end
        as varchar(255)
    )                              as SystemProductClass,
    c.TX_ID,
    c.IncomeInceptionDate,
    c.Revenue,
    c.Premium,
    c.SystemID,
    cast(
        case
            when c.RevenueCountry = 'KOREA' then 'SOUTH KOREA'
            when c.RevenueCountry = 'INDIA CONSULTING' then 'INDIA'
            when c.RevenueCountry = 'Viet Nam' then 'Vietnam'
            else c.RevenueCountry
        end
        as varchar(50)
    )                              as RevenueCountry,
    c.ClientID,
    c.DataSource,
    c.Segment,
    c.BusinessType,
    c.RecurringRevenue,
    c.RevenueCities,
    c.DUNSNO,
    c.Currency,
    cast(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(replace(c.GCID, '-', ''))), '') as varchar(50)) as GCID,
    c.[Source],
    cast(
        case
            when c.[Source] = 'CIS' and upper(c.[Product/Service]) = 'RDI' then 'Reward Data Intelligence (RDI)'
            when c.[Source] = 'CIS' and upper(c.[Product/Service]) = 'WRC' then 'Work, Rewards & Career (WRC)'
            when c.[Source] = 'CIS' then pm.[Product/Service]
            when c.DataSource = 'SPM' then c.[Product/Service]
            else coalesce(pm.[Product/Service], c.[Product/Service])
        end
        as varchar(255)
    )                              as [Product/Service],
    cast(
        case
            when c.[Source] = 'CIS' and upper(c.[Product/Service]) in ('RDI', 'WRC') then null
            when c.[Source] = 'CIS' then pm.[SubProduct/Service]
            when c.DataSource = 'SPM' then c.[SubProduct/Service]
            else coalesce(pm.[SubProduct/Service], c.[SubProduct/Service])
        end
        as varchar(255)
    )                              as [SubProduct/Service]
from fx_converted c
left join {{ ref('stg_billing__product_mapping') }} pm
    on upper(c.SystemProductClass) = upper(pm.SystemProductClass)

        Currency,
        -- labels are 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> year is the first 4 chars, month is chars 6-7
        try_cast(left(RateLabel, 4) as int)         as RateYear,
        try_cast(substring(RateLabel, 6, 2) as int) as RateMonth,
        Rate
    from fx_unpivoted
    where Rate is not null
),

-- latest available month-end rate within each (currency, year)
fx_year as (
    select Currency, RateYear, Rate
    from (
        select Currency, RateYear, Rate,
               row_number() over (partition by Currency, RateYear order by RateMonth desc) as rn
        from fx_parsed
        where RateYear is not null
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),

-- fallback: the currency's latest year, for income years with no rate at all
fx_latest as (
    select Currency, Rate
    from (
        select Currency, Rate,
               row_number() over (partition by Currency order by RateYear desc) as rn
        from fx_year
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),

-- FX convert: non-USD net brokerage -> USD. Join on Currency + inception year (latest rate that
-- year); fall back to the currency's latest year. USD passes through unchanged.
fx_converted as (
    select
        u.DataSource,
        u.RevenueCountry,
        u.AccountName,
        u.AccountHandler,
        u.Insurer,
        u.ClassOfBusiness,
        u.SourceProduct,
        u.CreateDate,
        u.InceptionDate,
        cast(
            case
                when u.Currency = 'USD' or u.Currency is null then u.NetBkgAmount
                else u.NetBkgAmount * coalesce(fx.Rate, fxl.Rate)
            end
            as decimal(18,2)
        )                          as NetBkgUsd,
        u.Currency,
        u.FullTeam,
        u.TransactionRef,
        u.Gcid
    from unioned u
    left join fx_year fx
        on u.Currency = fx.Currency
       and year(u.InceptionDate) = fx.RateYear
    left join fx_latest fxl
        on u.Currency = fxl.Currency
),

-- Client masterlist keyed by account name (Eclipse SG exact match) -- the list contains
-- duplicates, so dedupe to one row per name, resolved by lowest ClientID.
client_by_name as (
    select AccountKey, MasterAccountName, MasterGcid, Tier, ClientCountry, WtwIndustry
    from (
        select
            upper(ltrim(rtrim(cast(Account as varchar(500)))))  as AccountKey,
            cast(Account as varchar(500))                       as MasterAccountName,
            cast(GCID as varchar(50))                           as MasterGcid,
            cast(Tier as varchar(50))                           as Tier,
            cast([Client Country] as varchar(100))              as ClientCountry,
            cast([WTW Industry] as varchar(255))                as WtwIndustry,
            row_number() over (
                partition by upper(ltrim(rtrim(cast(Account as varchar(500)))))
                order by ClientID
            ) as rn
        from {{ source('bronze_billing', 'src_billing_client_list') }}
        where Account is not null
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),

-- Fuzzy tier for Eclipse SG: masterlist keyed by the normalized name (normalize_client_name
-- macro -- strips "(Singapore) (FOR ... USE ONLY)" tails, punctuation, legal suffixes).
-- Deduped to one row per key, resolved by lowest ClientID.
client_by_normname as (
    select NormKey, MasterAccountName, MasterGcid, Tier, ClientCountry, WtwIndustry
    from (
        select
            {{ normalize_client_name("upper(ltrim(rtrim(cast(Account as varchar(500)))))") }} as NormKey,
            cast(Account as varchar(500))                       as MasterAccountName,
            cast(GCID as varchar(50))                           as MasterGcid,
            cast(Tier as varchar(50))                           as Tier,
            cast([Client Country] as varchar(100))              as ClientCountry,
            cast([WTW Industry] as varchar(255))                as WtwIndustry,
            row_number() over (
                partition by {{ normalize_client_name("upper(ltrim(rtrim(cast(Account as varchar(500)))))") }}
                order by ClientID
            ) as rn
        from {{ source('bronze_billing', 'src_billing_client_list') }}
        where Account is not null
    ) t
    where rn = 1 and NormKey <> ''
),

-- Client masterlist keyed by dash-stripped GCID (Saiba / eGlobal / GSWin match) -- deduped
client_by_gcid as (
    select GcidKey, MasterAccountName, MasterGcid, Tier, ClientCountry, WtwIndustry
    from (
        select
            nullif(ltrim(rtrim(replace(cast(GCID as varchar(50)), '-', ''))), '') as GcidKey,
            cast(Account as varchar(500))                       as MasterAccountName,
            cast(GCID as varchar(50))                           as MasterGcid,
            cast(Tier as varchar(50))                           as Tier,
            cast([Client Country] as varchar(100))              as ClientCountry,
            cast([WTW Industry] as varchar(255))                as WtwIndustry,
            row_number() over (
                partition by nullif(ltrim(rtrim(replace(cast(GCID as varchar(50)), '-', ''))), '')
                order by ClientID
            ) as rn
        from {{ source('bronze_billing', 'src_billing_client_list') }}
        where GCID is not null
    ) t
    where rn = 1
)

-- Strings originate from staging VIEWS, so every string column is re-cast here (Fabric Warehouse
-- CTAS infers nvarchar on uncast view passthroughs). Dates/decimals pass through safely.
select
    cast(c.DataSource as varchar(50))                                        as DataSource,
    cast(c.RevenueCountry as varchar(50))                                    as RevenueCountry,
    cast(c.AccountName as varchar(500))                                      as AccountName,
    cast(c.AccountHandler as varchar(255))                                   as AccountHandler,
    cast(c.Insurer as varchar(500))                                          as Insurer,
    cast(c.ClassOfBusiness as varchar(255))                                  as ClassOfBusiness,
    cast(coalesce(pm.[Product/Service], c.SourceProduct) as varchar(255))    as Product,
    cast(pm.[SubProduct/Service] as varchar(255))                            as SubProduct,
    c.CreateDate,
    c.InceptionDate,
    c.NetBkgUsd,
    cast(c.Currency as varchar(10))                                          as Currency,
    cast(c.FullTeam as varchar(500))                                         as FullTeam,
    cast(c.TransactionRef as varchar(150))                                   as TransactionRef,
    cast(coalesce(cbn.MasterAccountName, cbf.MasterAccountName, cbg.MasterAccountName) as varchar(500)) as MasterAccountName,
    cast(coalesce(cbn.Tier, cbf.Tier, cbg.Tier) as varchar(50))                            as Tier,
    cast(coalesce(cbn.ClientCountry, cbf.ClientCountry, cbg.ClientCountry) as varchar(100)) as ClientCountry,
    cast(coalesce(cbn.WtwIndustry, cbf.WtwIndustry, cbg.WtwIndustry) as varchar(255))      as WtwIndustry,
    cast(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(replace(coalesce(c.Gcid, cbn.MasterGcid, cbf.MasterGcid), '-', ''))), '') as varchar(50)) as GCID,
    cast(
        case
            when cbn.AccountKey is not null then 'Exact Name'
            when cbf.NormKey    is not null then 'Fuzzy Name'
            when cbg.GcidKey    is not null then 'GCID'
        end
        as varchar(20)
    )                                                                            as ClientMatchMethod
from fx_converted c
left join {{ ref('stg_billing__product_mapping') }} pm
    on upper(ltrim(rtrim(c.ClassOfBusiness))) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(pm.SystemProductClass)))
left join client_by_name cbn
    on c.DataSource = 'ECLIPSE SG'
   and upper(ltrim(rtrim(c.AccountName))) = cbn.AccountKey
left join client_by_normname cbf
    on c.DataSource = 'ECLIPSE SG'
   and {{ normalize_client_name("upper(ltrim(rtrim(c.AccountName)))") }} = cbf.NormKey
left join client_by_gcid cbg
    on c.DataSource <> 'ECLIPSE SG'
   and nullif(ltrim(rtrim(replace(c.Gcid, '-', ''))), '') = cbg.GcidKey

-- DQ: Clients in fct_billing_baseline that are NOT in the client masterlist.

-- GCIDStatus: 'Client With GCID' (len>=7) | 'Wait to check with ECS' (short GCID) | 'NO GCID' (null/empty)

        SystemID
    from {{ ref('fct_billing_baseline') }}
),

masterlist as (
    select
        lower(ltrim(rtrim(cast(ClientID as varchar(50)))))   as ClientIDKey
    from {{ source('bronze_billing', 'src_billing_client_list') }}
    where ClientID is not null
),

missing as (
    select distinct
        tx.Account,
        tx.DUNSNO,
        tx.GCID,
        tx.[Data Source],
        tx.ClientID,
        tx.RevenueCountry,
        tx.SystemID,
        case
            when tx.GCID is null or len(tx.GCID) = 0 then 'NO GCID'
            when len(tx.GCID) >= 7                    then 'Client With GCID'
            else                                           'Wait to check with ECS'
        end as GCIDStatus
    from tx
    left join masterlist m
        on lower(ltrim(rtrim(tx.ClientID))) = m.ClientIDKey

model.apac_sales_etl.fct_crm_crb_pipelin.name: fct_crm_crb_pipeline
model.apac_sales_etl.fct_crm_crb_pipelin.description: Gold CRB sales pipeline fact (apac_crm_gold). int_crm__pipeline_enriched filtered to Corporate Risk & Broking per NB2 STEP 2 (drop CIS / ICT form / HWC form / non-CRB owner LOBs / H&B profit centres / non-CRB product-class prefixes), with the Japan-desk reassignment (31 owners -> CRB + Japan) and FinanceLevelReallocated (Asia Specialty -> Account Country for the 9 APAC markets; Fac Team stays Asia Spec). Scenario row-doubling model: every opportunity emitted once per Scenario ('Standard'/'Reallocated') -- filter to one Scenario in the report to avoid double-counting.
