model.apac_sales_etl.fct_crm_crb_pipelin.raw_code:
-- Mart: CRB sales pipeline fact (gold -> apac_crm_gold)
-- Filters int_crm__pipeline_enriched to Corporate Risk & Broking per NB2 (02_silver_notebook_crm_crb)
-- STEP 2, applies the Japan-desk reassignment, computes the reallocation, then emits every opportunity
-- TWICE via a Scenario column (row-doubling scenario model). Canonical column vocabulary kept.
--
-- Scenario model: FinanceLevel is always the true (standard) finance level. FinanceLevelReallocated is the
-- SCENARIO-EFFECTIVE column that joins to the Country dim in Power BI (drives RLS + market grouping):
--   Scenario = 'Standard'    -> FinanceLevelReallocated = FinanceLevel            (official book)
--   Scenario = 'Reallocated' -> FinanceLevelReallocated = reallocated value       (reallocated book)
-- One one-direction relationship fact[FinanceLevelReallocated] -> Country: no bridge, no bidirectional
-- cross-filter, so no RLS leakage. A restricted market manager sees reallocated-in deals in the
-- Reallocated scenario (those rows' FinanceLevelReallocated = their market). Filter to ONE Scenario
-- (default 'Standard') in the report to avoid double-counting.
--
-- Japan-desk (NB2 STEP 2, before the filter): the 31 owners (ref_crm_japan_desk, matched on the
--   Colleague-Involved name = Owner) -> OwnerBusinessName = CORPORATE RISK & BROKING, FinanceLevel = JAPAN.
-- CRB filter (NB2 conditions 1-7): drop CIS data version / ICT form / HWC form / non-CRB owner LOBs /
--   H&B profit centres / non-CRB product-class prefixes; keep CRB business only.
-- FinanceLevelReallocated: Asia Specialty rows route to a real APAC market via AccountCountry; Fac Team
--   (Globs = FACULTATIVE) stays Asia Spec; non-market stays Asia Spec. CRB-only column. Overrides:
--   ref_crm_crb_forced_asia_virtual seed forces listed OpptyIDs to Asia Spec; Malaysia stays Asia Spec
--   (not routed); Macau/Macao -> Hong Kong.
-- Naming note: this mart emits the GLOB column as `Globs` (CRB-specific); enriched keeps `Glob`.
--   AnzOpptyType is dropped here (legacy CRB output drops ANZ_OpptyType); enriched + APAC fact keep it.
--   MappedCountry (geo lookup) is no longer surfaced -- FinanceLevel is the country/finance dimension; the
--   geo lookup stays internal to enriched (backfills ServiceOfficeCountry / AccountCountry only).
--
-- Deferred (separate models): assumed-pipeline union (FX) and the v_crb_* split views.
-- Column trimming deferred -- full enriched set kept for now (per current decision).

with enr as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_crm__pipeline_enriched') }}
),

japan_desk as (
    select distinct trim(upper(OwnerName)) as OwnerName from {{ ref('ref_crm_japan_desk') }}
),

-- Manual override list: OpptyIDs forced to stay Asia Specialty in the reallocated book,
-- regardless of AccountCountry (e.g. specialty deals booked to a Singapore account that
-- should NOT reallocate into the Singapore market). Maintained in a seed.
forced_asia_virtual as (
    select distinct trim(cast(OpptyId as varchar(50))) as OpptyId
    from {{ ref('ref_crm_crb_forced_asia_virtual') }}
),

-- Japan-desk reassignment -> CRB business + Japan finance level (applied before the CRB filter)
jd as (
    select
        e.*,
        case when j.OwnerName is not null then 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING' else e.OwnerBusinessName end as CrbBusinessName,
        case when j.OwnerName is not null then 'JAPAN' else e.FinanceLevel end as CrbFinanceLevel
    from enr e
    left join japan_desk j on trim(upper(e.Owner)) = j.OwnerName
),

-- CRB scope (NB2 STEP 2, conditions 1-7) on the post-reassignment values
filtered as (
    select * from jd
    where (DataVersion is null or upper(DataVersion) not like '%CIS%')                 -- 1 drop legacy CIS
      and (FormName is null or upper(FormName) not like '%ICT%')                        -- 2 drop ICT forms
      and CrbBusinessName = 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING'                                  -- 3 CRB only
      and (FormName is null or upper(FormName) <> 'HWC FORM')                           -- 4 drop HWC form
      and (OwnerLobName is null or upper(OwnerLobName) not in (                         -- 5 drop non-CRB owner LOBs
            'HEALTH AND BENEFITS LOB', 'HUMAN CAPITAL AND BENEFITS HQ LOB',
            'INTEGRATED AND GLOBAL SOLUTIONS LOB', 'RETIREMENT LOB'))
      and (ProfitCenter is null or upper(ProfitCenter) not like '%H&B%')                -- 6 drop H&B profit centres
      and (ProductClass is null or (                                                    -- 7 drop non-CRB product classes
            upper(ProductClass) not like 'H&B%'  and upper(ProductClass) not like 'W&R%'
            and upper(ProductClass) not like 'RET:%' and upper(ProductClass) not like 'INV:%'
            and upper(ProductClass) not like 'EX:%'  and upper(ProductClass) not like 'OUT:%'
            and upper(ProductClass) not like 'IGS:%' and upper(ProductClass) not like 'ICT:%'))
),

-- FinanceLevelReallocated: re-route Asia Specialty to a real APAC market using the Account Country; Fac Team
-- stays Asia Specialty; anything not resolving to a routed market stays Asia Specialty. (AccountCountry
-- drives ~65% of the routable Asia-Specialty revenue vs ~8% for the geo lookup, so we route on it alone.)
-- Overrides (2026-07-06): (a) OpptyIDs in ref_crm_crb_forced_asia_virtual are forced to Asia Specialty
-- regardless of country; (b) Malaysia is NOT a routed market -- Malaysian accounts stay Asia Specialty;
-- (c) Macau / Macao accounts route to Hong Kong.
realloc as (
    select
        f.*,
        case
            when fav.OpptyId is not null then 'ASIA SPECIALTY'                          -- (a) manual force list (seed)
            when upper(f.CrbFinanceLevel) <> 'ASIA SPECIALTY' then f.CrbFinanceLevel
            when upper(f.Glob) = 'FACULTATIVE' then 'ASIA SPECIALTY'                    -- Fac Team stays
            when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) in (
                    'SINGAPORE','INDONESIA','INDIA','PHILIPPINES','CHINA','HONG KONG','TAIWAN',
                    'JAPAN','VIETNAM','VIET NAM','SOUTH KOREA','KOREA, REPUBLIC OF','KOREA (REPUBLIC OF)',
                    'MACAU','MACAO')                                                     -- (c) Macau/Macao -> Hong Kong
                then case
                        when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) = 'VIET NAM' then 'VIETNAM'
                        when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) in ('KOREA, REPUBLIC OF','KOREA (REPUBLIC OF)') then 'SOUTH KOREA'
                        when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) in ('MACAU','MACAO') then 'HONG KONG'
                        else upper(trim(f.AccountCountry))
                     end
            else 'ASIA SPECIALTY'                                                       -- (b) Malaysia, Brunei, etc. stay Asia Specialty
        end as FinanceLevelReallocatedCalc
    from filtered f
    left join forced_asia_virtual fav on trim(cast(f.OpptyID as varchar(50))) = fav.OpptyId
),

-- Scenario row-doubling: emit every opportunity once per scenario. FinanceLevelReallocated (the
-- Country-join / RLS column) resolves to the true FinanceLevel in the Standard book and to the
-- reallocated value in the Reallocated book. FinanceLevel itself stays the true standard level in both.
scenarios as (
    select cast('Standard' as varchar(20)) as Scenario
    union all
    select cast('Reallocated' as varchar(20)) as Scenario
),

doubled as (
    select
        s.Scenario,
        case when s.Scenario = 'Reallocated'
             then r.FinanceLevelReallocatedCalc
             else r.CrbFinanceLevel
        end as FinanceLevelReallocatedEff,
        r.*
    from realloc r
    cross join scenarios s
)

select
    cast(r.Scenario as varchar(20)) as Scenario,
    r.DunsNumber,
    r.OriginatingLeadID,
    r.GUID,
    r.OpptyID,
    r.OpptyName,
    r.Description,
    r.FormName,
    r.ProductClass,
    r.ProductSubClass,
    r.Account,
    r.ParentAccount,
    r.GlobalParentAccount,
    r.AccountCountry,
    r.GCID,
    r.NGCID,
    r.Tiers,
    r.Industry,
    r.PrimarySicCode,
    r.CCY,
    r.EstRevenueLCY,
    r.EstRevenueUSD,
    r.WtRevenueLCY,
    r.WtRevenueUSD,
    r.PremiumUSD,
    r.LikelihoodOfWin,
    r.Probability,
    r.Frequency,
    r.PipelinePhase,
    r.OpptyStatus,
    r.OpptyState,
    r.OpptyType,
    r.OpptySubType,
    -- AnzOpptyType intentionally dropped from CRB (matches legacy CRB output, which drops ANZ_OpptyType)
    -- Japan-desk-adjusted business; finance level (= Japan for Japan-desk, Asia Spec etc otherwise)
    cast(r.CrbBusinessName as varchar(255)) as OwnerBusinessName,
    r.OwnerSegmentLobName,
    r.OwnerLobName,
    r.OwnerCountry,
    r.Glob as Globs,
    cast(r.CrbFinanceLevel as varchar(255)) as FinanceLevel,
    cast(r.FinanceLevelReallocatedEff as varchar(255)) as FinanceLevelReallocated,
    r.ServiceOfficeCountry,
    r.ServiceRegion,
    r.ServiceOffice,
    r.ProfitCenter,
    r.OpportunityOwner,
    r.OpportunityOwnerUpn,
    r.Owner,
    r.ColleagueInvolvedUpn,
    r.TagList,
    r.FirstIncomeDate,
    r.InceptionDate,
    r.ProjectStartDate,
    r.CloseDate,
    r.CreatedOn,
    r.ModifiedOn,
    r.SourceCampaign,
    r.DataVersion,
    r.OppLink
from doubled r

model.apac_sales_etl.fct_crm_crb_pipelin.raw_code:
-- Mart: CRB sales pipeline fact -- STANDARD variant (gold -> apac_crm_gold)
-- Full standalone CRB transformation, pre-scenario design: one row per opportunity. FinanceLevel
-- (true standard finance level) and FinanceLevelReallocated (Asia Specialty routed to a real APAC
-- market) are plain columns on the same row -- no Scenario toggle, no row-doubling. This is the
-- formal transformation as it existed before the Standard/Reallocated scenario model was added to
-- fct_crm_crb_pipeline. Business logic (Japan-desk reassignment, CRB filter, reallocation) is
-- defined independently here -- not derived from, or dependent on, the scenario mart.

--   Colleague-Involved name = Owner) -> OwnerBusinessName = CORPORATE RISK & BROKING, FinanceLevel = JAPAN.

--   H&B profit centres / non-CRB product-class prefixes; keep CRB business only.
-- FinanceLevelReallocated: Asia Specialty rows route to a real APAC market via AccountCountry; Fac Team
--   (Globs = FACULTATIVE) stays Asia Spec; non-market stays Asia Spec. CRB-only column.
-- Naming note: this mart emits the GLOB column as `Globs` (CRB-specific); enriched keeps `Glob`.
--   AnzOpptyType is dropped here (legacy CRB output drops ANZ_OpptyType); enriched + APAC fact keep it.
--   MappedCountry (geo lookup) is no longer surfaced -- FinanceLevel is the country/finance dimension; the
--   geo lookup stays internal to enriched (backfills ServiceOfficeCountry / AccountCountry only).
--
-- Deferred (separate models): assumed-pipeline union (FX) and the v_crb_* split views.
-- Column trimming deferred -- full enriched set kept for now (per current decision).

with enr as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_crm__pipeline_enriched') }}
),

japan_desk as (
    select distinct trim(upper(OwnerName)) as OwnerName from {{ ref('ref_crm_japan_desk') }}
),

-- Manual override list: OpptyIDs forced to stay Asia Specialty in the reallocated column,
-- regardless of AccountCountry (e.g. specialty deals booked to a Singapore account that
-- should NOT reallocate into the Singapore market). Maintained in a seed.
forced_asia_virtual as (
    select distinct trim(cast(OpptyId as varchar(50))) as OpptyId
    from {{ ref('ref_crm_crb_forced_asia_virtual') }}
),

-- Japan-desk reassignment -> CRB business + Japan finance level (applied before the CRB filter)
jd as (
    select
        e.*,
        case when j.OwnerName is not null then 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING' else e.OwnerBusinessName end as CrbBusinessName,
        case when j.OwnerName is not null then 'JAPAN' else e.FinanceLevel end as CrbFinanceLevel
    from enr e
    left join japan_desk j on trim(upper(e.Owner)) = j.OwnerName
),

-- CRB scope (NB2 STEP 2, conditions 1-7) on the post-reassignment values
filtered as (
    select * from jd
    where (DataVersion is null or upper(DataVersion) not like '%CIS%')                 -- 1 drop legacy CIS
      and (FormName is null or upper(FormName) not like '%ICT%')                        -- 2 drop ICT forms
      and CrbBusinessName = 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING'                                  -- 3 CRB only
      and (FormName is null or upper(FormName) <> 'HWC FORM')                           -- 4 drop HWC form
      and (OwnerLobName is null or upper(OwnerLobName) not in (                         -- 5 drop non-CRB owner LOBs
            'HEALTH AND BENEFITS LOB', 'HUMAN CAPITAL AND BENEFITS HQ LOB',
            'INTEGRATED AND GLOBAL SOLUTIONS LOB', 'RETIREMENT LOB'))
      and (ProfitCenter is null or upper(ProfitCenter) not like '%H&B%')                -- 6 drop H&B profit centres
      and (ProductClass is null or (                                                    -- 7 drop non-CRB product classes
            upper(ProductClass) not like 'H&B%'  and upper(ProductClass) not like 'W&R%'
            and upper(ProductClass) not like 'RET:%' and upper(ProductClass) not like 'INV:%'
            and upper(ProductClass) not like 'EX:%'  and upper(ProductClass) not like 'OUT:%'
            and upper(ProductClass) not like 'IGS:%' and upper(ProductClass) not like 'ICT:%'))
),

-- FinanceLevelReallocated: re-route Asia Specialty to a real APAC market using the Account Country; Fac Team
-- stays Asia Specialty; anything not resolving to a routed market stays Asia Specialty. (AccountCountry
-- drives ~65% of the routable Asia-Specialty revenue vs ~8% for the geo lookup, so we route on it alone.)
-- Overrides (2026-07-06): (a) OpptyIDs in ref_crm_crb_forced_asia_virtual are forced to Asia Specialty
-- regardless of country; (b) Malaysia is NOT a routed market -- Malaysian accounts stay Asia Specialty;
-- (c) Macau / Macao accounts route to Hong Kong.
realloc as (
    select
        f.*,
        case
            when fav.OpptyId is not null then 'ASIA SPECIALTY'                          -- (a) manual force list (seed)
            when upper(f.CrbFinanceLevel) <> 'ASIA SPECIALTY' then f.CrbFinanceLevel
            when upper(f.Glob) = 'FACULTATIVE' then 'ASIA SPECIALTY'                    -- Fac Team stays
            when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) in (
                    'SINGAPORE','INDONESIA','INDIA','PHILIPPINES','CHINA','HONG KONG','TAIWAN',
                    'JAPAN','VIETNAM','VIET NAM','SOUTH KOREA','KOREA, REPUBLIC OF','KOREA (REPUBLIC OF)',
                    'MACAU','MACAO')                                                     -- (c) Macau/Macao -> Hong Kong
                then case
                        when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) = 'VIET NAM' then 'VIETNAM'
                        when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) in ('KOREA, REPUBLIC OF','KOREA (REPUBLIC OF)') then 'SOUTH KOREA'
                        when upper(trim(f.AccountCountry)) in ('MACAU','MACAO') then 'HONG KONG'
                        else upper(trim(f.AccountCountry))
                     end
            else 'ASIA SPECIALTY'                                                       -- (b) Malaysia, Brunei, etc. stay Asia Specialty
        end as FinanceLevelReallocatedCalc
    from filtered f
    left join forced_asia_virtual fav on trim(cast(f.OpptyID as varchar(50))) = fav.OpptyId
)

Reallocated rows carry FINAL NETTED values (standard + zero-sum reallocation deltas, summed at fact grain -- no visible +/- movement rows). Only one Scenario is filtered at a time in Power BI. Per-year totals identical across scenarios; pre-2026 value-identical. fct_finance_mr_plan stays untouched.
model.apac_sales_etl.fct_finance_mr_plan.raw_code:
-- Mart: Finance MR Plan -- Scenario fact (Standard / Reallocated)
-- Source:  {{ ref('int_finance__mr_accumulated') }} (standard plan, all years)
--          + {{ ref('int_finance__mr_realloc_accumulated') }} (zero-sum reallocation deltas)
-- Output:  apac_finance_gold.fct_finance_mr_plan_reallocated (table)
-- Same shape as the CRM CRB scenario fact: every book emitted twice via a Scenario column.
--   Scenario = 'Standard'    : the plan exactly as accumulated (no reallocation).
--   Scenario = 'Reallocated' : FINAL NETTED plan values -- standard + reallocation deltas
--                              summed at fact grain, so each row already carries the
--                              calculated number (no visible +/- movement rows).
-- Both scenarios are complete books; only one is filtered at a time in Power BI (Scenario
-- slicer / toggle, like CRB V1). Per-year grand totals are identical across scenarios
-- (reallocation is zero-sum; guarded by tests/assert_finance_mr_realloc_zero_sum.sql).
-- Years with no reallocation data (pre-2026) are value-identical in both scenarios.
-- fct_finance_mr_plan (single-scenario parity mart) stays untouched for existing visuals.
-- NOTE: the internal Scenario column of int_finance__mr_accumulated means Plan/Actual/
-- Forecast -- unrelated to this mart's Standard/Reallocated Scenario.

with standard_rows as (
    select Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard, Amount
    from {{ ref('int_finance__mr_accumulated') }}
    where Scenario = 'Plan'
),

-- Reallocated book = standard + deltas, netted to one row per fact-grain bucket.
reallocated_rows as (
    select
        Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard,
        sum(Amount) as Amount
    from (
        select Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard, Amount
        from standard_rows

        union all

        select Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard, Amount
        from {{ ref('int_finance__mr_realloc_accumulated') }}
    ) u
    group by Country, MrGlob, IncomeType, RevenueType, PlanPeriod, GlobForDashboard
)

select
    cast('Standard' as varchar(20))        as Scenario,
    cast(Country as varchar(255))          as Country,
    cast(MrGlob as varchar(255))           as MRGLOB,
    cast(IncomeType as varchar(255))       as IncomeType,
    cast(RevenueType as varchar(50))       as RevenueType,
    cast(Amount as decimal(18,2))          as [Plan],
    cast(PlanPeriod as datetime2(6))       as PlanPeriod,
    cast(GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GLOBforDashboard
from standard_rows

union all

select
    cast('Reallocated' as varchar(20))     as Scenario,
    cast(Country as varchar(255))          as Country,
    cast(MrGlob as varchar(255))           as MRGLOB,
    cast(IncomeType as varchar(255))       as IncomeType,
    cast(RevenueType as varchar(50))       as RevenueType,
    cast(Amount as decimal(18,2))          as [Plan],
    cast(PlanPeriod as datetime2(6))       as PlanPeriod,
    cast(GlobForDashboard as varchar(255)) as GLOBforDashboard
from reallocated_rows

test.apac_sales_etl.assert_finance_mr_he.name: assert_finance_mr_header_positions
test.apac_sales_etl.assert_finance_mr_he.raw_code:
-- Singular test: Finance MR positional-drift guard.
-- The raw MR sheet is consumed by POSITION (Actual=Column30-41, Forecast=Column45-56,
-- Plan=Column58-69). If finance inserts/moves a column in CRB Revenue.xlsx, every block
-- shifts silently and wrong numbers ship. The header row (RowIndex = 8) must therefore
-- read January..December at the expected positions -- this test returns the offending
-- row (or an arbitrary row if the header row is missing entirely) and fails the build.

select RowIndex, Country, Glob, Actual01, Actual12, Forecast01, Forecast12, Plan01, Plan12
from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_revenue') }}
where RowIndex = 8
  and not (
        ltrim(rtrim(Actual01))   = 'January'  and ltrim(rtrim(Actual12))   = 'December'
    and ltrim(rtrim(Forecast01)) = 'January'  and ltrim(rtrim(Forecast12)) = 'December'
    and ltrim(rtrim(Plan01))     = 'January'  and ltrim(rtrim(Plan12))     = 'December'
  )

union all

-- Header row missing entirely (sheet restructured / short file): surface one row.
select top 1 RowIndex, Country, Glob, Actual01, Actual12, Forecast01, Forecast12, Plan01, Plan12
from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_revenue') }}
where not exists (
    select 1 from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_revenue') }} where RowIndex = 8
)

union all

-- FY label moved/missing (RowIndex 6 must read 'FY26'-style): the year gate derives the
-- source year from this cell, so its absence means the year silently falls back to
-- getdate() -- fail visibly instead.
select RowIndex, Country, Glob, Actual01, Actual12, Forecast01, Forecast12, Plan01, Plan12
from {{ ref('stg_finance__mr_revenue') }}
where RowIndex = 6
  and ltrim(rtrim(coalesce(Actual01, Forecast01, Plan01))) not like 'FY[0-9][0-9]'

test.apac_sales_etl.assert_finance_mr_re.name: assert_finance_mr_realloc_zero_sum
test.apac_sales_etl.assert_finance_mr_re.raw_code:
-- Singular test: reallocation deltas must be zero-sum per year.
-- Every dollar moved INTO a market must come OUT of Asia Specialty -- so the deltas sum to
-- ~0 within each YearKey (tolerance 1.00 for decimal rounding). A non-zero year means the
-- inbound/outbound arms diverged (bad join, lost rows, mapping gap) and the reallocated
-- mart's grand total would no longer match fct_finance_mr_plan.

select
    YearKey,
    sum(Amount) as NetAmount
from {{ ref('int_finance__mr_realloc_accumulated') }}
group by YearKey
having abs(sum(Amount)) > 1

macro.dbt_fabric.fabric__get_catalog.macro_sql:
{% macro fabric__get_catalog(information_schemas, schemas) -%}

    {% set query_label = apply_label() %}
    {%- call statement('catalog', fetch_result=True) -%}
        {{ get_use_database_sql(information_schemas.database) }}
        with
        principals as (
            select
                name as principal_name,
                principal_id as principal_id
            from
                sys.database_principals {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        schemas as (
            select
                name as schema_name,
                schema_id as schema_id,
                principal_id as principal_id
            from
                sys.schemas {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        tables as (
            select
                object_id,
                name as table_name,
                schema_id as schema_id,
                principal_id as principal_id,
                'BASE TABLE' as table_type
            from
                sys.tables {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        tables_with_metadata as (
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                coalesce(tables.principal_id, schemas.principal_id) as owner_principal_id,
                table_type
            from
                tables
            join schemas on tables.schema_id = schemas.schema_id
        ),

        views as (
            select
                object_id,
                name as table_name,
                schema_id as schema_id,
                principal_id as principal_id,
                'VIEW' as table_type
            from
                sys.views {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        views_with_metadata as (
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                coalesce(views.principal_id, schemas.principal_id) as owner_principal_id,
                table_type
            from
                views
            join schemas on views.schema_id = schemas.schema_id
        ),

        tables_and_views as (
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                principal_name,
                table_type
            from
                tables_with_metadata
            join principals on tables_with_metadata.owner_principal_id = principals.principal_id
            union all
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                principal_name,
                table_type
            from
                views_with_metadata
            join principals on views_with_metadata.owner_principal_id = principals.principal_id
        ),

        cols as (

            select
                c.object_id,
                c.name as column_name,
                c.column_id as column_index,
                t.name as column_type
            from sys.columns as c {{ information_schema_hints() }}
            left join sys.types as t on c.system_type_id = t.system_type_id
        )

        select
            DB_NAME() as table_database,
            tv.schema_name as table_schema,
            tv.table_name,
            tv.table_type,
            null as table_comment,
            tv.principal_name as table_owner,
            cols.column_name,
            cols.column_index,
            cols.column_type,
            null as column_comment
        from tables_and_views tv
        join cols on tv.object_id = cols.object_id
        where ({%- for schema in schemas -%}
            upper(tv.schema_name) = upper('{{ schema }}'){%- if not loop.last %} or {% endif -%}
        {%- endfor -%})

        order by column_index
        {{ query_label }}

        {%- endcall -%}

    {{ return(load_result('catalog').table) }}

{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_fabric.fabric__list_noncluster.macro_sql:
{% macro fabric__list_nonclustered_rowstore_indexes(relation) -%}
  {% call statement('list_nonclustered_rowstore_indexes', fetch_result=True) -%}

    SELECT i.name AS index_name
    , i.name + '__dbt_backup' as index_new_name
    , COL_NAME(ic.object_id,ic.column_id) AS column_name
    FROM sys.indexes AS i
    INNER JOIN sys.index_columns AS ic
        ON i.object_id = ic.object_id AND i.index_id = ic.index_id and i.type <> 5
    WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('{{ relation.schema }}.{{ relation.identifier }}')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT  obj.name AS index_name
    , obj.name + '__dbt_backup' as index_new_name
    , col1.name AS column_name
    FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
    INNER JOIN sys.objects obj
        ON obj.object_id = fkc.constraint_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.tables tab1
        ON tab1.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.schemas sch
        ON tab1.schema_id = sch.schema_id
    INNER JOIN sys.columns col1
        ON col1.column_id = parent_column_id AND col1.object_id = tab1.object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.tables tab2
        ON tab2.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.columns col2
        ON col2.column_id = referenced_column_id AND col2.object_id = tab2.object_id
    WHERE sch.name = '{{ relation.schema }}' and tab1.name = '{{ relation.identifier }}'

  {% endcall %}
  {{ return(load_result('list_nonclustered_rowstore_indexes').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
